title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Photoroom
description_html:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

What you will own

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work remotely, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Chef(fe) de projet déploiement solution SAAS
description_html:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense.

Vous serez amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Pour accompagner le développement de nos projets et répondre aux besoins de nos clients, nous renforçons notre équipe Consulting. Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de projet déploiement pour piloter l’implémentation de la solution Vertical Expense chez nos clients, en collaboration avec les équipes internes (technique, produit, CSM) et les interlocuteurs client (DSI, DAF, DRH, métiers).

Tu interviendras au cœur des projets, de la compréhension des besoins, au paramétrage de la solution, en passant par l’accompagnement des utilisateurs.

Tes responsabilités :

  • Piloter les projets de déploiement de A à Z, du cadrage à la mise en production.

  • Analyser les besoins des clients et les conseiller sur l’optimisation de leurs processus.

  • Animer les ateliers projet et assurer la coordination des différentes parties prenantes.

  • Rédiger et faire valider les spécifications fonctionnelles et les livrables projet.

  • Organiser et réaliser le paramétrage de la solution selon les règles métier du client.

  • Accompagner les intégrations techniques (connecteurs ERP/SIRH, SSO, API…)

  • Assurer les phases de tests, recettes, formations, et transfert vers les équipes support.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos processus de delivery.

  • Être un relais actif du retour client vers les équipes produit.

  • Assurer le suivi des projets et garantir la satisfaction client.


Ce qu’on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as une expérience réussie en tant que chef(fe) de projet fonctionnel ou consultant(e) fonctionnel(le) dans le cadre d’un projet de déploiement (Solutions Finance, RH, ERP ou SIRH... est un plus).

  • Tu maîtrises les bases de données et SQL, et tu comprends les environnements web, API, SSO et formats d’échange.

  • Tu possèdes un bon niveau fonctionnel, notamment sur les sujets de comptabilité, frais professionnels et processus métier.

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les projets multi-interlocuteurs et sais adopter une posture de conseil fonctionnel auprès des clients.

  • Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se), réactif(ve) et communiques avec aisance à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise en croissance, avec une base clients qui se développe et des contextes d’utilisation variés.

  • Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, où ton expertise et tes actions auront un impact concret sur la réussite des projets et la satisfaction client.

  • Travailler autour d’un produit reconnu et apprécié par ses clients.

  • Rejoindre une équipe expérimentée et bienveillante, favorisant le partage de connaissances, tout en développant ton expertise fonctionnelle grâce à des missions variées et un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien téléphonique RH.

  2. Première mise en situation : découverte d’une solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais et échange autour de ses fonctionnalités.

  3. Seconde mise en situation (en autonomie) : cas pratique de paramétrage sur un environnement de test.

  4. Échange avec la Head of Delivery, le Project Manager et RH (1h).

Poste basé à Aix-en-Provence, rémunération : 45k à 50k€ brut annuel selon le profil.

title: Experienced / Senior Fullstack Engineer (Productivity)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Doctrine
description_html:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.
Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.
 
Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :
1. Analyse de documents
2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques
3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation
 
C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.
 
Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !
 
A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠
  • Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.
  • Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.
  • Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.
  • Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles.
  • Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Tu maîtrises TypeScript/JavaScript côté back et front, et tu es à l'aise sur une stack moderne en production (Node.js, React ou équivalent).
  • Tu as une vraie culture backend — modélisation de données, APIs robustes, performance, gestion de la dette technique. Le front ne te fait pas peur, mais c'est le back qui te définit.
  • Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire.
  • Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie.
  • Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits.
  • Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée.

    • Les à côtés du poste 👁
  • Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
  • 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,…
  • 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre
    •  
  • Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

description_html:
Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

Role Overview

Docebo is hiring a Legal Counsel to own the negotiation and management of our commercial contract ecosystem end to end. You'll work directly with global Sales, Dealdesk, and RFP teams as the trusted legal advisor on contract matters, balancing business goals with risk in a fast-moving SaaS environment.

What You'll Do

  • Manage the full negotiation lifecycle for Master Service Agreements, partnership agreements, Statements of Work, SLAs, Software Service Addendums (including AI terms), NDAs, and other client contracts, from drafting through execution.

  • Partner with Sales, Dealdesk, Partnership, Security, and Finance teams as a trusted advisor, chairing or joining meetings as needed to move deals forward and resolve risk.

  • Draft and refine legal terms, contract templates, and amendments, and improve the workflows around them.

  • Run forensic reviews of client contracts to catch risk early and keep terms consistent with Docebo's standards.

  • Advise Sales on contract questions, products, disputes, and terminations.

  • Support the RFP team on tender responses and major sales documents.

  • Support the Partnership team in negotiating strategic partnership agreements, including professional services/subcontractor, referral, and reseller agreements.

  • Maintain contract records for benchmarking, and help tighten contract administration processes over time.

title: Staff Research Engineer - Multimodal Generative Modelling
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Synthesia
description_html:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

Synthesia's long-term vision is to build the best human-interactive models: systems that don't just talk to people, but perceive and respond to them, reacting to a user's actions and emotions, not only their words. Today over 60,000 businesses rely on our platform, and the next leap in what we can offer them depends on models that combine text, audio, and video into a single real-time interactive experience.

As a Staff Research Engineer, you'll join the Voice team within our 40+ person R&D department, but your scope will extend well beyond voice. You'll help define and drive that broader vision across teams, proposing ambitious research directions and taking direct ownership of the design and implementation of its most critical components. You'll work directly with our voice lead and collaborate tightly with our video teams and other senior members of the org.

Concretely, you'll work on voice to voice models that produce text and voice simultaneously. Models that can reason, interrupt the user with back channeling and talk. Models that feel like you are having a natural conversation with, without the feeling of turn taking that is dominant in current speech to speech models. Your role would be to partner in defining a roadmap, implementing it and shipping the outcomes to product.

What you'll do

  • Shape our roadmap to create new model capabilities and unlock new functionality for our customer base, on both short and long time horizons.

  • Propose novel multi-modal system architectures (especially text and voice).

  • Develop and evaluate streaming and conversational systems for low-latency, interactive voice-video synthesis.

  • Design solutions that reinforce emotional expressiveness and natural interaction.

  • Implement and bring designs to life, from pretraining through post-training.

  • Integrate and test novel architectures (neural codecs, diffusion, flow-matching) to enhance realism and responsiveness.

  • Define new evaluation metrics for conversational systems, including latency-aware and interaction-based measurements.

  • Track the latest research in audio-visual diffusion, autoregressive models, neural codecs, and multimodal LLMs.

  • Curate new datasets to complement existing data.

  • Lead post-training initiatives like DPO, fine-tuning, and distillation to bring models to shipping quality.

  • Ship models to production with optimised runtime to serve customers, and address their feedback thereafter.

You'll thrive in this role if you have

  • The ability to bring novel ideas and designs that advance the field of interactive multimodal systems.

  • Strong understanding of generative modelling, ideally applied to sequential or multimodal data.

  • Hands-on experience with large language models or similar transformer-based architectures.

  • High proficiency in PyTorch, including distributed training and model optimization.

  • A solid grasp of time-series modeling and tokenization, preferably in the context of audio, speech, or video.

  • A demonstrated ability to prototype quickly, test hypotheses, and iterate efficiently.

  • Proven experience training deep learning models end-to-end, from data preparation through evaluation.

  • Strong general software engineering skills, enabling contributions to a large, shared research infrastructure.

Particularly relevant experience

  • Having shipped a generative model into a live product used at meaningful scale, not just published or prototyped it.

  • Working on conversational or interactive systems where latency, responsiveness, and user experience were first-class constraints, not afterthoughts.

  • Working on LLMs with large scale trainings leadings to models with decent reasoning capabilities

  • Owning a research problem end to end: from architecture proposal through pretraining, post-training, and production deployment.

  • Collaborating across modalities or teams (e.g. audio and video, or research and product) to ship a unified system.

Bonus points for

  • Experience with real-time or streaming architectures.

  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art architectures in audio and speech generation, such as diffusion models, neural codecs, flow-matching models, or autoregressive decoders.

  • Excellence in one or more of the following modalities: voice, text, video.

  • Evidence of original research contributions, such as publications or open-source work at top-tier venues (e.g. NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, ICLR, Interspeech).

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

Role overview

Synthesia is used by over 90% of the Fortune 100, and the largest deployments now run thousands of creators across dozens of markets, languages, and compliance regimes. What decides whether those accounts expand or stall is not another avatar, it is whether admins, legal, and programme owners can actually stay in control.

You'll own that layer end to end: workspace setup and governance, the content lifecycle, and the analytics and integrations that close the loop. This is the work that turns a proof of concept into a seven-figure renewal, and right now it is wide open.

Why this role now

AI video has crossed from experiment to standard tooling inside the world's biggest companies. The next phase of growth is won or lost on whether we can make that scale safe and manageable. That is your remit.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the end-to-end roadmap for content lifecycle, governance, and the operational layer that keeps enterprise deployments running - from workspace setup through compliance controls

  • Getting close to enterprise customers: understanding how IT admins, legal teams, programme managers and content owners think about governance, and what "in control" actually looks like at scale

  • Translating that into clear product direction, what to build, in what order, and why, and keeping engineering and design aligned to it as the strategy evolves

  • Working closely with the engineering manager and designer in the team; writing clear specs, making good calls on trade-offs, and providing the context that helps engineers build the right thing first time

  • Partnering with Solutions, CS, and Legal on complex enterprise deals. These features are frequently deal-critical and the commercial loop matters

  • Defining the metrics that tell us whether this layer is working: adoption of admin tooling, compliance feature usage, reduction in support escalations related to governance gaps

Who you are

You've excited by the challenge that comes with untangling the inherent complexity of enterprise platform products. You understand that governance and compliance work isn't glamorous, but you know it's the difference between a proof of concept and a seven-figure renewal.

You can hold a conversation with a CISO and with a content creator, and understand what each of them needs from the same system.

You may be a good fit if you bring

  • Significant experience owning a critical product domain - setting strategy, not just executing it

  • A track record of connecting product outcomes to commercial results: ARR, retention, expansion, or equivalent

  • Comfortable working across a broad surface area. You can prioritise ruthlessly and make the case for what gets built next

  • Strong written communication: PRDs, strategy docs, and customer insight summaries that others can act on without a follow-up

  • Ability to ramp quickly on to the complexity of enterprise buying motions. You'll be close to the commercial team on complex deals and that context matters

  • Based in London or open to regular travel; the team is London-anchored and in-person time matters

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. Strong candidates rarely match a list exactly, and we'd rather hear from you.

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

Location

Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office or remote from Europe.

 

Global benefits:

  • You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity.

  • You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

  • Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person.

  • Work from home budget

  • Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

  • Generous referral scheme

  • Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater—our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit)

 

Benefits specific to UK:

  • Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants

  • 5% pension match

  • Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the London office

title: Senior Software Engineer, Blockchain Protocols
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Chainalysis
description_html:
The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimizes data labeling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Our data and solutions have been used to solve some of the world's most high-profile criminal cases and grow consumer access to cryptocurrency safely. Now, by pairing the industry's most trusted blockchain data with agents that reason, investigate, and act, we help our customers scale their workflows as the cryptocurrency economy becomes increasingly mainstream.

The Protocols team delivers high-quality, low-latency blockchain datasets that serve as the trusted foundation for Chainalysis’ investigation, compliance, data and security products. We currently support more than 30 blockchains, translating on-chain data into actionable intelligence.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Architect and evolve scalable, reliable, and performant systems for ingesting and parsing complex blockchain data.

  • Leverage AI-native engineering workflows (LLMs, automated agents) to increase team velocity and code quality.

  • Provide blockchain protocol expertise (EVM, UTXO, etc.) to the team and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Manage the full software development lifecycle, including production monitoring, debugging, and maintaining reliability of our pipelines and services.

  • Work closely with Product Managers to ensure our datasets meet the evolving needs of the crypto ecosystem.

  • Guide junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, design docs, and technical mentorship.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Extensive experience building distributed systems or data-intensive applications.

  • Experience working with TypeScript either in a professional or personal capacity

  • A bias to ship and the ability to iterate quickly in a fast-moving environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI assisted development tools to increase velocity while maintaining reliable, maintainable code.

  • A deep understanding and experience of at least one Blockchain protocol

You might also have:

  • Knowledge and experience with non-EVM chains such as Solana, TON, and Sui.

  • Experience with indexing and ETL at scale (Spark/Databricks).

  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and managing services in Kubernetes.

  • Contributions to open-source blockchain projects.

Technologies we use:

  • Languages: Java, TypeScript

  • Data Processing: Spark, Databricks, PostgreSQL

  • Infrastructure: AWS (Serverless & EKS), Kubernetes, Terraform

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Finance Partner
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ankar
description_html:
The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., IP) — yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work, sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that.

Ankar is building the AI Platform for the Trillion Dollar Innovation Economy — a suite of tools that helps inventors explore, create, and protect ideas. We’re removing the friction from the invention process, starting with IP protection and expanding toward creation and exploration.

We’re already seeing this vision come to life:

  • We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

  • We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Fenwick

  • Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We’re just getting started.

Ankar is looking for a strategic and hands-on Finance hire to own our financial operations and planning. You will be responsible for building a world-class finance function that supports our growth, ensures financial discipline, and enables long-term success.

What you’ll be doing:

  • You’ll work closely with the founders, operations, and revops team to shape financial strategy, manage investor relations, and ensure compliance with relevant standards. You’ll also help build scalable systems and processes to support a fast-growing, high-performance technology company.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading financial planning, reporting and forecasting

  • Managing budgeting, reporting, and compliance processes

  • Overseeing cash flow, capital allocation, and risk management

  • Supporting fundraising (preparation of Series B round), governance, and investor communications

  • Implementing scalable financial systems and controls, including invoicing and revenue collection

  • Managing relationships with external accountants in the UK & US

  • Ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards

  • Owning payroll for our employees end-to-end

What we are looking for

  • Proven experience in hands-on finance operations role, for example:

    • First or second finance hire at a high growth start-up or scale up

    • Commercial finance, FPR&A or Finance business partner in larger tech company

  • Proven experience in a Finance role that required tactical execution as well as strategic judgment

  • Strong understanding of financial regulations and reporting standards

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Attention to detail

  • A pragmatic, hands-on approach to solving complex financial challenges

Ideally, you would also have:

  • Experience working with venture-backed startups, supporting finance events such as equity fundraises and secondary transactions

  • Experience using (or implementing) ai-native (and other relevant) tooling within the finance stack

  • ACA/ACCA/CIMA qualified (or equivalent)

  • Familiarity with financial modelling and scenario planning

  • Exposure to international finance and multi-entity structures

  • Experience with cashflow management strategies

What success in this role looks like in 6/12 months:

  • In 6 months, you will have a fully automated invoicing system in place, seamlessly connecting your CRM to your accounting platform for issuing and tracking invoices. You will also have completed a full review of finance partners and made any necessary changes to optimise performance and cost.

  • In 12 months, you will have built a resilient treasury management system and, in collaboration with Revenue Operations, implemented a scalable reporting engine to support growth and decision-making.

 

This role is not for you if...

  • You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction.

  • You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information.

  • You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products.

  • You take it personally when ideas are challenged, priorities shift, or work gets redirected. We care more about finding the right answer than defending a particular one.

 

What we put behind our people

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

  • Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings.

  • Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office.

  • Cycle to work: Green Commute initiative scheme (up to £3k) to help you get a new bike tax-free.

  • Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from.

What else you might want to know

  • Location: Scrutton Street, London

  • Contract: Full-time

  • Compensation: We pay competitive salaries and will reward you with a substantial equity package.

  • Hiring process (the process can be as fast as you want it to be):

    • (1) 30min introductory chat with operations lead

    • (2) 30 minute chat with founder

    • (3) onsite: 45min case study with founder and 1h case study with operations lead

    • (4) 20min meeting with advisor

You'll partner closely with the CTO, engineering and product teams to help define the long-term technical components and scaling of our platform and technology.

As one of the most senior engineers in the business, you'll contribute to tackling our most complex technical challenges as well as technical investigations and prototyping new ideas and innovations.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing pragmatic technical thinking with hands-on engineering, and who thrives on solving difficult problems that don't fit neatly into a sprint backlog.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

  • Partner with Omaze's existing Principal Software Engineer to help drive innovation and new technologies.

  • Work closely with the CTO and Engineering Managers to investiagte key technology decisions.

  • Act as a technical advisor for complex initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure and aligned with our long-term strategy.

  • Extend the engineering organisation's capacity for ad-hoc technical investigations, proof of concepts, rapid prototyping and strategic experiments.

  • Lead technical discovery for high-risk or high-ambiguity initiatives before they enter delivery.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve platform reliability, performance and developer experience.

  • Champion modern mature software engineering practices, including automated testing, observability, CI/CD and cloud-native architecture.

  • Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, helping to raise the technical capability of the wider engineering team.

  • Showcase Omaze’s technical innovations internally and externally.

  • Facilitate technology reviews and encourage thoughtful technical discussions across teams.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend where they can create meaningful value for Omaze.

  • Foster a culture of curiosity, continuous learning and pragmatic decision-making.

🤩 About You

You'll be an experienced software engineer who has operated at Staff or Principal level and enjoys solving organisation-wide technical challenges.

You'll likely bring:

  • Significant experience designing and evolving large-scale systems and modern cloud-based applications.

  • Genuine curiosity with creative thinking around emerging technologies and AI-assisted engineering.

  • A proven track record of influencing technical strategy without relying on line management authority.

  • Ability to move freely between go-fast experimentation and system-wide integrity.

  • Excellent software engineering fundamentals and experience across backend systems, APIs and cloud infrastructure.

  • High performance mindset, able to balance scaling challenges against product need.

  • Strong architectural judgement with the ability to balance technical excellence against commercial priorities.

  • The ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems, identify root causes and propose pragmatic solutions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A collaborative, humble approach and a genuine desire to help others succeed.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Significant experience as a mobile engineer, with strong hands-on expertise in React Native and Expo, including EAS build and submission workflows.

  • Experience with automated testing for mobile unit, integration, and end-to-end (e.g. Jest, Maestro, Appium).

Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £100 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

We are looking for an experienced Senior Performance Marketing Manager to lead our global Above-the-Line (ATL) media strategy and drive sustainable business growth across international markets. This role is responsible for developing data-driven media strategies, managing agency partnerships, and ensuring fully integrated marketing campaigns that deliver measurable commercial outcomes. Working cross-functionally with Marketing, Analytics and Product, you will oversee end-to-end ATL planning, execution, measurement and optimisation.

🔧 What You'll Be Doing

Lead Global Media Strategy

Define and execute Omaze's global ATL media strategy, ensuring investment supports commercial objectives and market growth.

  • Lead the development and execution of the global ATL media strategy, ensuring investment supports each market's commercial objectives and growth targets.

  • Translate business priorities into effective media strategies that balance brand building with measurable performance outcomes.

  • Identify new media opportunities, channels and market trends to drive competitive advantage.

Drive Integrated Marketing

  • Partner with Growth, Product, Brand and Creative teams to deliver fully integrated campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels.

  • Ensure ATL activity complements wider acquisition, retention and brand initiatives.

  • Align media investment with broader business priorities and product launches.

Own Media Planning & Agency Partnerships

  • Build strong relationships with global media agency partners to deliver best-in-class planning, buying and optimisation.

  • Review, challenge and approve media strategies and plans, ensuring they are aligned with business objectives, audience insights and commercial targets.

Optimise Marketing Investment

  • Own and manage significant ATL media budgets in partnership with Finance and Growth teams.

  • Develop investment scenarios based on commercial objectives, market conditions and growth opportunities.

  • Continuously optimise budget allocation using campaign performance, customer insights and business priorities.

Collaborate on Creative Excellence

  • Foster a culture of continuous creative testing and optimisation to improve campaign performance.

Lead & Influence

  • Act as the senior performance marketing expert across the organisation.

  • Mentor and develop team members while promoting a culture of curiosity, accountability and continuous improvement.

🤩 About You

You're an experienced marketing leader who understands how to combine strategic brand investment with commercial performance. You enjoy solving complex growth challenges using data, experimentation and collaboration, and you're comfortable influencing senior stakeholders across the business.

You're equally confident discussing media strategy with agencies, commercial performance with Finance, measurement methodologies with Analytics, and campaign execution with Creative teams. You thrive in fast-moving environments where innovation, testing and continuous optimisation are valued.

You'll also bring:

  • Significant experience leading ATL media strategy across multiple markets with responsibility for large-scale media budgets.

  • A proven track record of delivering measurable business growth through integrated media planning and optimisation.

  • Deep expertise in media effectiveness, attribution, Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), incrementality testing and experimentation frameworks.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex performance data into clear strategic recommendations.

  • Experience managing and influencing media agencies to deliver best-in-class planning, buying and optimisation.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership.

  • A collaborative leadership style with a passion for developing high-performing teams and building strong cross-functional partnerships.

description_html:
Director of Marketing Data Science & Analytics

Location: Holborn, London (Hybrid – 3 days per week)

Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £100 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

Why You’ll Love Working at Omaze:

  • Growth: Omaze is one of the fastest-growing companies in the world.

  • Impact: Join a team of world changers dedicated to creating a ripple effect of good.

  • Pioneering: Be part of something no one has done before.

  • Culture: We work hard, grow together, and spread joy along the way

🔑 About The Job

We're looking for a Director of Marketing Data Science & Analytics to build and lead a brand-new capability within our growing Data, Analytics, and Insights team.

This is a unique opportunity to shape how one of the UK's fastest-growing consumer brands measures marketing performance. You'll build a high-performing team spanning Marketing Analytics, Marketing Data Science and Marketing Engineering, creating the measurement capabilities, technology foundations and analytical standards that help us make smarter investment decisions and accelerate growth.

Working closely with the VP, Head of Data & Analytics, you'll partner with senior leaders across Marketing, Growth, Finance and Engineering to establish a best-in-class marketing measurement function. From Marketing Mix Modelling and experimentation to attribution, mobile measurement and marketing technology, you'll ensure the business has one trusted view of marketing performance and the confidence to make data-led decisions.

You'll be equally comfortable setting long-term strategy and rolling up your sleeves to solve complex problems, helping establish a culture where evidence, experimentation and commercial impact sit at the heart of every marketing decision.

🔧 What You'll Be Doing

  • Build, hire and lead a high-performing team across Marketing Analytics, Marketing Data Science and Marketing Engineering, creating the culture, standards and operating model for a new function.

  • Own end-to-end marketing measurement, bringing together Marketing Mix Modelling, attribution, mobile measurement and platform reporting into a single source of truth.

  • Lead and evolve Omaze's Marketing Mix Modelling programme, ensuring outputs directly influence investment and budget allocation decisions.

  • Establish experimentation as standard practice through incrementality testing, geo experiments, holdouts, conversion lift studies, ghost ads and switchback designs.

  • Own our mobile measurement strategy, including MMP configuration and reconciliation of SKAdNetwork, AdAttributionKit and post-IDFA measurement.

  • Lead the evolution of our marketing technology ecosystem, including customer data platforms, attribution tools, CRM platforms, identity solutions, server-side tagging, conversion APIs and audience activation.

  • Define and govern the commercial metrics that matter, including CAC, LTV/CAC, payback, contribution margin and net contribution, partnering closely with Finance to ensure consistent business reporting.

  • Drive the transition from descriptive reporting to predictive and prescriptive analytics, including lifetime value modelling, acquisition forecasting and media optimisation.

  • Shape build-versus-buy decisions across the marketing technology landscape and manage strategic vendor relationships, contracts and budgets.

  • Lead our first-party data and privacy-era measurement strategy across the UK and Germany, ensuring compliance with GDPR and local privacy requirements.

  • Act as the trusted analytics partner to senior leaders, translating complex analysis into clear recommendations and board-ready insights.

  • Raise the bar for experimentation, analytical rigour and storytelling across the organisation while championing data quality, instrumentation and measurement best practice.

  • Represent Marketing Data Science & Analytics within the wider Data & Analytics function, ensuring alignment with engineering, analytics and data science standards.

🤩 About You

You'll be an experienced data and analytics leader who combines deep technical expertise with outstanding commercial judgement and people leadership. You're passionate about building teams, solving complex measurement challenges and helping businesses make better decisions through data.

You'll bring:

  • Significant leadership experience at Director level, with a track record of building and scaling high-performing analytics, data science or marketing measurement teams.

  • Deep expertise across Marketing Mix Modelling, attribution, experimentation and incrementally testing.

  • Strong knowledge of mobile measurement, privacy-first attribution and the evolving post-IDFA ecosystem, including SKAdNetwork and AdAttributionKit.

  • Extensive experience designing and leading modern marketing technology ecosystems, including CDPs, server-side tagging, conversion APIs and identity solutions.

  • A proven ability to partner with Finance to define and govern commercial marketing metrics such as CAC, LTV/CAC, payback and contribution.

  • Outstanding communication skills, with experience influencing senior executives and presenting complex analysis to board-level stakeholders.

  • Expert SQL skills alongside strong Python or R for statistical analysis and modelling.

  • Hands-on experience applying advanced customer segmentation techniques, predictive modelling and causal inference methods.

  • Experience working within high-growth consumer, subscription or direct-response businesses with significant paid media investment.

  • A track record of building marketing measurement or MarTech capabilities from the ground up.

  • Experience with modern Marketing Mix Modelling approaches and causal inference techniques, including difference-in-differences, synthetic control and instrumental variables.

  • Experience operating across multiple European markets, ideally including the UK and Germany, with an understanding of regional privacy requirements.

  • Strong knowledge of the modern data stack and enough technical depth to partner effectively with Data Engineering and set engineering standards.

🙌What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

Diversity statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

Onwards Together!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

Location: United Kingdom

Our Team's Vision:

The Customer Experience (CX) organisation is responsible for delivering successful customer outcomes across the entire post-sales lifecycle. Within CX, Professional Services plays a key role in translating customer goals into practical delivery: designing, deploying, and operationalising Illumio solutions in a way that builds confidence, drives value, and supports long-term customer success.

 

Your Impact:

As a Professional Services Consultant, you consistently deliver high-impact results, applying your full qualifications and experience to drive outcomes and add measurable value. You work independently on customer deployments and problem resolution while collaborating with senior team members on more complex architectural considerations.
In this role, you will:

  • Act as a trusted advisor for clients, assisting them with the integration of Illumio into their environments

  • Manage deployments and upgrades of the Illumio platform, ensuring successful implementation by coordinating timeframes and required resources.

  • Conduct technical reviews and provide guidance on change preparation for Illumio deployments.

  • Assist in the development of Illumio-specific API scripts to enhance service deployment, monitoring, and management.

  • Provide best practices, documentation, and recommendations for optimizing the use of Illumio.

  • Prepare and maintain project documentation throughout the engagement.

  • Monitor and troubleshoot the Illumio deployment, addressing anomalies and performance issues.

  • Serve as the primary interface between client teams and Illumio’s product and support teams.

  • Provide metrics and reporting on the Illumio deployment’s effectiveness.

  • Support internal teams with integration documentation and assist with security ruleset and policy development.

  • Facilitate testing and validation of the Illumio platform for client service teams.

  • Conduct knowledge transfer and training sessions on the Illumio product set for client teams.

  • Complete necessary administrative documentation, including timesheets and weekly reports.

Your Toolkit:

You bring both technical depth and professional maturity to the role, including:

  • 3 plus years of consulting or advisory experience.

  • Strong experience with Linux (CentOS/Red Hat preferred) and Windows Server platforms.

  • Experience with cloud computing service provider models (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI)

  • Experience with container platform architecture (Kubernetes, Openshift, etc.)

  • Experience with automation and scripting tools (e.g., Bash, Python, Ruby, Chef, Puppet, Ansible).

  • Expertise in networking concepts, including network flows, protocols, and application security controls.

  • Problem-solving ability to diagnose and resolve issues in unfamiliar technology environments.

  • Ability to work with evolving technology and quickly adapt to new tools.

  • Client-facing skills, including conflict resolution and project management experience.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences.

  • Broad understanding of IT infrastructure.

  • Existing Experience within Professional Services team of a security vendor is a strong advantage.

  • Willingness to travel to HQ in Silicon Valley for product training and knowledge development.

  • Ability to quickly assimilate new product knowledge and apply it effectively in customer environments.

  • Prior experience with Illumio is not required - training will be provided.

description_html:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who's passionate about building reliable, scalable infrastructure that helps developers ship better software faster. You'll design and maintain our Kubernetes-based multi-cloud platform, improve our monitoring and observability tools, and collaborate with product and engineering teams to solve real problems in real time. This is a role where you'll own the systems that power Camunda, drive automation that raises the bar for everyone, and mentor others who want to do the same. If you thrive on building things that work well and don't break when they shouldn't, we'd love to talk.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Design and maintain our infrastructure – You'll evolve our Kubernetes-based, multi-cloud platform architecture, ensuring it's available, scalable, and fault-tolerant. You'll establish configuration best practices and network services that our teams rely on.

  • Build observability that matters – Implement and improve monitoring and alerting tools that give both SREs and developers real visibility into system health and performance. Make it easy for teams to understand what's happening across our stack.

  • Own your systems end-to-end – You'll adopt a "you build it, you run it" mentality, which means participating in on-call rotations and being the go-to person when things need quick fixes. You'll create runbooks and automation that turn complex problems into manageable processes.

  • Ship features and improvements with product teams – Work cross-functionally with product engineering, product management, and support to define and deliver features that move the needle. Bring your expertise to the table early and often.

  • Push automation to the next level – Identify repetitive work and automate it away. Share what you learn with your teammates so everyone gets better at their craft. We measure progress by the quality of our systems, not hours worked.

  • Be the expert others learn from – Help less experienced engineers tackle complex infrastructure challenges. Break down technical problems into clear steps and support others in growing their skills. 

What You Bring:

Must Haves:

  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes – You've built, deployed, and maintained Kubernetes clusters in production environments. You understand how to manage workloads, networking, and storage at scale.

  • Infrastructure as code expertise – You're fluent in tools like Terraform (or similar IaC tools) and know how to version, test, and safely deploy infrastructure changes.

  • Demonstrated experience in monitoring and observability – You've worked with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms to instrument systems and alert on what matters.

  • Strong 3rd-level support and incident response skills – You've responded to production incidents, diagnosed complex issues, and communicated clearly with stakeholders under pressure. You understand root cause analysis and how to prevent issues from happening again.

  • A passion for automation and raising the quality bar – You see manual work as a problem to be solved. You care deeply about building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and easy to understand.

  • Responsible use of AI tools – You leverage AI for research, code review, documentation, test generation, and automation to improve your effectiveness. You know how to validate AI outputs against requirements, never share confidential or personal data with AI systems without authorization, and always retain human accountability for decisions and deliverables.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with major cloud providers – You've worked with AWS (EKS), Google Cloud Platform (GKE), or similar managed Kubernetes services.

  • ArgoCD or GitOps workflows – You've used declarative, Git-driven infrastructure management to keep systems in sync.

  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages – You write scripts and automation tools that solve real problems.

  • Experience with SLOs and alerting frameworks – You've helped teams define meaningful service level objectives and set up alerts that don't cry wolf.

About the role:

Backend engineering rarely gets this consequential. As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's Core / API & Process Automation team, you'll work on the beating heart of Camunda 8 — the event-sourced, distributed workflow engine that executes business-critical processes for thousands of customers and, through them, millions of people worldwide. Because you sit at the core, one well-made improvement propagates outward through every integration and product built on top of it: a small change here is felt everywhere.

Few systems demand this. You'll squeeze the last drops of performance out of the hot paths. You'll design maintainability and versioning strategies for an engine that must faithfully replay every event it has ever written — forever. You'll reason about the concurrency between the engine advancing a process and a user mutating that same process in the same instant. And you'll hold an unforgiving bar: data must never be corrupted, and a process must never get stuck — because when it does, customers lose money. That single constraint cascades into some of the hardest technical and product challenges you'll find anywhere.

You'll also help define what comes next. Enabling AI agents to integrate with and drive the engine is cutting-edge work, and the features we ship create real aha moments and stretch what the industry thinks automation can do. You'll do it alongside a world-spanning team of highly skilled, highly motivated engineers who share one goal: make Camunda the best workflow engine in the world. As a senior here you set the technical bar — you take ambiguous problems and give them shape, lead the hard discussions, and make the people around you better.

  6. Advocate for documentation as a critical part of the user experience, bringing the user’s perspective into product discussions and influencing design and implementation where appropriate.

  7. Continuously improve the structure, clarity, and completeness of the documentation based on analytics, user feedback, and your own insights.

  8. Collaborate with other writers and the broader Documentation team to share best practices, contribute to team goals, and evolve our documentation tooling and standards.

What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of technical writing experience and a strong portfolio of developer-focused content such as user guides, installation guides, API references, tutorials, and technical blog posts.

  • Proven experience of maintaining, troubleshooting, configuring, and extending documentation site infrastructure and deployment pipelines, preferably using Docusaurus.

  • Hands-on experience with Java, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and related technologies, and a proven ability to deeply understand, use, and test complex technical products (ideally with Camunda 8 or similar products).

  • Software engineering experience, or proficiency with one or more programming languages.

title: Associate Partnership Manager

description_html:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We are now looking for a Partnerships Associate to support our growth journey in the UK. This is a junior-level role designed for early-career professionals with a strong interest in finance, accounting, or Fintech. You’ll help identify and connect with potential partners, build a strong pipeline, and support the foundation for lasting commercial relationships. Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to develop into a full-cycle Partner Manager role, taking end-to-end ownership of strategic partnerships.

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

  • Partner Identification & Assessment: Research and identify prospective partners aligned with Moss’ strategic priorities and ideal customer profiles. Support the initial assessment of partners through qualitative and quantitative analysis (e.g., partner fit, customer base, integration potential).

  • Outreach & Pipeline Building: Own the top of the funnel for our partnerships pipeline. Proactively reach out to prospective partners via email, LinkedIn, events, and other channels. Engage partners with a clear value proposition and qualify initial interest.

  • Relationship Building & Support: Assist in building and maintaining strong working relationships with partners. Participate in partner calls and meetings, prepare follow-ups, and support ongoing communication. Help deliver value to partners by understanding their needs and coordinating with internal teams.

  • Process & Reporting: Track outreach and pipeline activity in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce). Share regular updates on partner funnel status and help improve outreach playbooks and processes. Collaborate with Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to ensure partner prospects are well aligned with Moss’ commercial strategy.

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in this role:

  • First experience (1-2 years of full-time work) in business development, partnerships, finance, accounting, or Fintech

  • Academic background in business, finance, economics, or similar fields

  • Fluent in English (C2/Native)

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Curious & Analytical: You’re structured in your research and bring insights into conversations.

  • Relationship— Oriented: You enjoy speaking to people, understand how to build rapport, and communicate with clarity.

  • Self-Starter: You take initiative, manage your own pipeline, and are eager to learn from every interaction.

  • Team Player: You collaborate closely with teammates and internal stakeholders to deliver joint results.

  • Growth-Driven: You’re looking to grow into a Partner Manager role over time and want to learn how to build high-impact commercial partnerships.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays
