title: Account Executive II DACH
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Pleo
description_html:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for an Account Executive to join our DACH Sales Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help drive the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals and be part of a collaborative and successful sales unit as we scale Pleo's expense management solution. If you're excited about converting new business and are passionate about SaaS outbound sales this is the opportunity for you!

What you'll be doing

As an Account Executive, you will:

  • Own the entire sales cycle - from outbound to qualification, product demos and deal conversion

  • Achieve new business revenue targets - focusing on building new relationships

  • Collaborate closely with the Customer Success team - to ensure the customers in your portfolio successfully adopt with Pleo

  • Become an expert in expense management

  • Give outstanding product presentations - acing those demos to get deals closed

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A track record of meeting sales quotas and targets - ideally including sourcing and closing your own deals

  • Great rapport building and confident presentation skills

  • Strong ability to accept feedback and adapt to new situations

  • Experience in outbound sales

  • Background in SaaS sales is preferred - ideally coming from an Account Executive closing role

  • Fluency in English and German

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our Sales Manager and work closely with teams in SDRs, Customer Success and Marketing. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to achieving revenue goals. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across product to ensure success

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Close your first key deals to drive impact in new business revenue

  • Build your own pipeline

  • Grow your skills in SaaS sales and expense management, taking on new challenges as Pleo continues to scale

Show the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us - with catering in our Lisbon, Copenhagen and London offices or a monthly lunch allowance paid directly together with your salary in other markets

  • Private health insurance to ensure you’re fit in body and mind to do your best work

  • In the UK, we offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Sales team we offer hybrid working, with up to two days a week from home three days a week in the London office

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We’re trialling MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and wellbeing support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kuro Technology
description_html:
tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the intelligence layer for the construction industry.

  • The largest construction enterprises in Europe, with a combined project volume of over €30bn annually, rely on Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.

  • Construction has the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM, PDFs, drawings, 3D models, images, calculations. At Kuro you can tackle the hardest applied AI problems everyday.

  • Curious about the bigger product challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build.

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is the intelligent project data system for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible.

After one year on the market leading construction enterprises with a combined construction volume >30 billion annually use Kuro everyday to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.

We are 16 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of ex-technical founders and builders that are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

The Opportunity

As Product Manager, you'll work on the platform at the heart of Kuro's product, building the foundational capabilities that enable our teams to deliver faster and scale with confidence. You'll help defining the strategy and execution, from the data domain model, project graphs, and ontologies to workflow abstractions and essential services such as permissions, document versioning, lineage, and collaboration.

Working closely with the Co-Founder & CPO, platform engineering, design, and our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), you'll ensure every investment accelerates the development of future use cases, making the platform more extensible, scalable, and powerful with every release.

 

What You'll Do

  • Be an active voice in roadmap creation, balancing immediate platform needs with long-term strategic investments.

  • Lead strategic initiatives to capture key decisions across the project lifecycle and evolve Kuro's scalable data domain model.

  • Define success metrics, use production data to iterate on platform capabilities, and communicate releases across the organization.

  • Make informed decisions on prioritization, scope, and sequencing, partnering with leadership on major architectural and new product bets.

  • Discover opportunities with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) and translate complex operational challenges into clear product requirements.

Your profile

  • 5+ years of product management experience building technical products, such as AI, automation, developer tooling, or enterprise software.

  • Proven experience shipping data platform products, APIs, or graph- and ontology-based systems.

  • Strong understanding of how LLM-powered products behave in production and the challenges of building AI-native products.

  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and balancing short-term needs with long-term platform investments.

  • Passion for understanding users' day-to-day workflows and a willingness to become a domain expert in the construction industry.

  • Fluent in German, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.

Bonus:

  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or workflow abstraction frameworks.

  • Founder experience or experience building products in an early-stage startup.

  • Experience in construction technology (ConTech), AEC software, or a related industry.

 

Why Kuro

You are joining Kuro when it matters most. The product is live, our customers are using it daily, but their journey with Kuro has only started, and you can shape it from the get-go. There is no playbook, the world is changing at an unprecedented speed, and you can shape how one of the most critical industries around the globe wins in this new era.

Explore the technical vision behind Kuro, from processing more than one million construction pages a month to entity resolution, evidence-linked answers, and 3D project graphs. Kuro Product Vision →

 

The process

  1. Talent Acquisition Call — Intro, logistics & fit (30 min)

  2. Impact Call: Deep dive with Jonas & Get to know Product (30 min)

  3. Challenge: A time-boxed product challenge (≤4 hours)

  4. Challenge review and deep dive (60 minutes)

  5. On-site Day — Meet the team and lunch/dinner

    • Culture Interview (30 Min)

    • Meet several team members

    • Go for lunch with the team

  6. Decision

Compensation: €85K – €110K • 0.05% – 0.15%

tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the AI foundation for the construction industry

  • Leading European construction enterprises with >€40bn in combined annual construction volume already rely on Kuro every day

  • Curious about the bigger engineering challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build.

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction.

After one year on the market, leading construction enterprises with a combined annual construction volume of >€40 billion use Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions. Backed by an €8 million seed round, we already process more than 1 million pages every month and expect that volume to grow 10x over the next six months.

We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

What You'll Do

Build and own end-to-end (AI) features

  • Design and implement new features to solve a specific user problem, such as document versioning or our agentic Chat.

  • From concept to DB schema, to optimizing LLMs, to UI. Own the full development lifecycle of customer-facing features.

  • Manage evaluations and scoring, and perform error analysis on new and shipped AI features.

Build the platform that abstracts workflow building

  • Contribute to the workflow harness, decision-trace standard, and eval tooling so a new use case ships in ~1 month

  • Build reusable human review & approval surfaces where trust in AI output is earned

Work on the construction ontology & project graph

  • Help model and evolve canonical entities of our customers

  • Contribute to entity resolution across sources: recognizing the same requirement, position, or price across BoQs, contracts, drawings, and bids

  • Build features so answers are evidence-linked and auditable, and decisions flow back into the graph

Contribute to scalable data pipelines & integrations

  • Extend our multi-modal ingestion of unstructured documents - PDFs, scans, drawings, and 3D models - orchestrated and cost-efficient at scale

  • Build read/write integrations with customer systems (document management, ERP/AVA), so workflows complete work end-to-end

Projects you would be involved in

Current & Past projects

  • Project & document versioning guaranteeing data lineage in construction projects

  • German tokenizer for construction-specific search

  • Document pipeline ingesting 10,000s of PDFs per day

  • Native BIM/DWG file support: ingesting and processing 3D models

  • Design the ontology v1 + graph schema: core construction entities, evidence links, and per-customer extension model

  • Build out our workflow harness to run agentic workflows for customers

Current Tech Stack

It is still day 0 for Kuro. Therefore, we are highly pragmatic with our tool choices. We believe in keeping it simple and moving quickly. You significantly help shape our tech stack decisions.

  • Web-App: Typescript

  • Database / Vector DB and File Storage: AWS RDS / Trubopuffer / AWS S3

  • Backend: Fastify API + Prisma ORM

  • Workflow Orchestrator: Prefect (Python)

  • Hosting: AWS Elastic Beanstalk

  • AI: Azure / OpenAI, Gemini, Cohere, AWS

  • Obsv., Eval. & Tracking: Langfuse, Datadog

Your profile

This is the perfect role for an experienced engineer who wants to join an early stage company that builds a high impact applied AI product

  • Bring 3+ years of experience as a (full-stack) software engineer in a fast-paced environment

  • Have proven experience delivering production-grade applied AI features to customers

  • Take full ownership of solving customer problems by designing and implementing AI features

  • Thrive in a small, accountable team with a high degree of ownership and a drive to make an impact

  • Communicate fluently in both spoken and written English

  • Enjoy working onsite with the team at our office in Factory Berlin Mitte every day

Bonus Points

  • You’ve started a company before or worked at a very early stage startup

  • You built side projects in the past - we’re excited to hear about these!

  • German-speaking (definitely not a must, we’re fully international)

Why Kuro

You’ll join at a point when customer demand is proven, but our product and platform are still yours to shape. You’ll own customer-facing features end to end while building the foundations beneath them, from ingestion pipelines and workflow infrastructure to our construction ontology and project graph.

Explore the technical vision behind Kuro, from processing more than one million construction pages a month to entity resolution, evidence-linked answers and 3D project graphs. Explore Kuro Engineering →

As Kuro grows, you can grow with it, whether as a leading individual contributor, technical leader or people manager.

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Call – Intro, motivation, logistics & fit (30 min)

  • Impact Interview – Deep dive into your experience, ownership & impact (60 min)

  • On-site Day

    • System Design – Designing under ambiguity & LLM craft (60 min)

    • AI-Native Coding – Hands-on coding with AI (45 min)

    • Final Culture Interview (approx. 45 min)

  • Reference calls

  • Decision

Unser Team ist vielfältig – wir sind über 50 Personen aus mehr als 16 Nationalitäten, mit einem Frauenanteil von 46 %. Und wir wachsen weiter!

Über Ostrom

Ostrom ist der digital-first Ökostromanbieter aus Berlin. Wir machen Energie einfach, transparent und fair: gute Preise, eine App, die wirklich funktioniert, und smarte Features wie Smartes Laden, dynamische Tarife und intelligente Verbrauchssteuerung. Wir wachsen schnell, sind von namhaften internationalen VCs finanziert und auf dem Weg zum profitablen Wachstum. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden in Berlin, der unser Marketing auf das nächste Level bringt.

Die Rolle

Als Head of Marketing (m/w/d) verantwortest du unsere Neukundengewinnung und unsere Marke. Du entwickelst die Strategie, baust das Team auf und treibst das Wachstum über alle Kanäle voran.   • Sehr gutes wirtschaftliches Verständnis: Du denkst in Unit Economics, Margen und Customer Lifetime Value

  • Builder-Mindset: Du kommst gut mit Unklarheit zurecht, priorisierst klar und bringst Dinge pragmatisch voran

Nice-to-Have

🤝 Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam: Teamarbeit steht bei uns im Mittelpunkt – und genauso feiern wir auch unsere Erfolge: mit regelmäßigen Happy Hours, Team-Ausflügen und unvergesslichen Company Events.

🌍 Work you way: Ob im Berliner Büro, im Homeoffice oder remote unter der Sonne – bei uns arbeitest du dort, wo du am produktivsten bist.

🚀 Wachse mit uns: Persönliche Entwicklung ist bei Ostrom keine Floskel. Wir unterstützen dich mit Lernbudgets und Raum zum Ausprobieren – damit du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln kannst.

description_html:
About Finto

Finto is on a mission to reinvent how enterprises run their finance operations. Starting with AI-powered automation for accounts payable, we eliminate manual invoice handling, supplier chasing, 3-Way-Matching and ERP data entry. Backed by Y Combinator, we're building the future of enterprise accounting.

Our mission is to free the world's finance teams from repetitive, low-value tasks so they can focus on impactful work. That starts with building a place where everyone can do their best work. Whether you're building on our platform, partnering with our customers, or shaping our story: We just make things finance teams want.

About the role

We are hiring an Entrepreneur in Residence to work directly with our CTO. You will take ownership of important, loosely defined problems and deliver results.

Your initial focus will be customer integrations and solution engineering. You will lead strategic customer initiatives, translate recurring needs into product direction, and help reduce the time our CTO spends on solution scoping. As you prove ownership, your scope can expand into product discovery, internal engineering, or AI adoption.

This is a hands-on role. You will build, investigate, make decisions, and follow through. It is not a support or project-management position.

What you’ll do

Lead strategic customer initiatives

Own important customer engagements from discovery through delivery. Join technical conversations, clarify requirements, and act as the CTO’s delegate where agreed. Turn recurring customer needs into clear input for the product roadmap.

Drive product and technical discovery

Turn open questions into specifications and prototypes. Evaluate whether we should build, buy, or integrate. Research technical options and recommend a clear course of action.

Improve how our engineers work

Remove friction from onboarding, permissions, tooling, and internal infrastructure. Build secure, self-service workflows that help engineers work effectively.

Lead practical AI adoption

Test new AI tools and workflows across Finto. Measure whether they improve speed or quality, train the team on useful applications, and introduce appropriate guardrails.

Your priorities will change as the company changes. One week you may scope an ERP integration. The next, you may prototype a product idea or improve an internal workflow.

What we’re looking for

  • You have built something from scratch and taken responsibility for the outcome.

  • You are comfortable working through ambiguity without waiting for detailed instructions.

  • You can understand software architecture, build prototypes, and work with modern AI and LLM tools.

  • You are familiar with Node.js, TypeScript, and integration-heavy systems.

  • You have worked at startup speed, whether as a founder, early engineer, forward-deployed engineer, or in a Founder’s Office or Chief of Staff role.

  • You communicate clearly in German and English.

  • You want to take on more responsibility as you grow.

Experience with ERP integrations, fintech, developer tooling, or customer-facing technical work is helpful but not required.

Working at Finto

  • Work with the founders on problems that directly affect customers and the company.

  • Take ownership early. Your scope will grow with the results you deliver.

  • Join our in-office team in Munich five days per week.

  • Receive 25 vacation days and two company-wide recharge days.

  • Build relationships through Finto’s Y Combinator and San Francisco network.

Interview process

  1. Introductory call: 20 minutes with our CEO

  2. Technical call: 30 minutes with our CTO

  3. Working session: 90-minute technical challenge

  4. Culture interview with our CPO

  5. Meet the team

  6. Offer

Compensation: €60K – €80K • Offers Equity

title: SAP Integration Architect

description_html:
About the role

We are looking for an SAP Integration Architect to own how Finto connects to SAP. Some of our customers run their finance operations on SAP, and no two landscapes look alike: R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, on-premise and cloud, Business One and Business ByDesign. You'll design how master data, invoices and postings move between those systems and our AI platform, and turn what starts as a bespoke integration into a product that goes live in weeks. This is a hands-on role, working directly with our CTO and the founding team: you'll set the architecture, write code, and sit across the table from customer IT. You're the first hire dedicated to SAP at Finto and you define what the practice becomes. We're headquartered in Munich, with roots in San Francisco through Y Combinator.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture from a customer's SAP system into Finto: master data, invoices, postings, write-back.

  • Choose the integration path per SAP flavour - OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI, file-based - and make that choice repeatable instead of re-deciding it per customer.

  • Build the connector platform: templates, validation, monitoring, and the tooling that makes every new landscape faster than the last.

  • Translate FI and MM process knowledge into specifications and field mappings our engineers build against.

  • Ship production code with the engineering team - same repo, same reviews, Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Be the SAP authority in the room: with customer IT, with their integration partners, and in our own technical conversations with prospects.

  • Set the standard for how Finto goes live on SAP, and move more of it into the product with every rollout.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of hands-on SAP integration work in real customer landscapes across R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, ideally more than one generation of them.

  • Deep knowledge of the accounts payable process in SAP: FI, MM, the document flow around incoming invoices, tax determination, and why the field a customer means is rarely the field the label says.

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We're looking for a hands-on engineer to take full ownership of new robotic subsystems from first idea to production-ready hardware. You combine strong mechanical design skills with practical lab experience and a keen sense for manufacturability. Above all, you're someone who doesn't wait to be told what's next. You see what needs to happen, take initiative, and enjoy working openly in a fast-moving, international team that's growing together.

You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions. You believe the best work happens in an environment where people support each other, share knowledge, and grow together.

What You’ll Build

  • Own the full development cycle of robotic subsystems, from concept through rapid prototyping, iterative improvement, and deployment

  • Design complex mechanical systems and integrate mechanical and electrical components into functional robotics solutions

  • Build and test prototypes hands-on, including assembly, troubleshooting, and iterative validation

  • Collaborate with the electronics and software team on system integration and performance

  • Optimize designs for manufacturability and assembly to enable scalable production

  • Manage outsourcing partners and suppliers to transition prototypes into production-ready systems

What You Bring

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or related field

  • 3+ years experience in automation/robotics, with strong track record designing complex electromechanical systems, from prototype to production

title: IT Administrator
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Cosuno
description_html:
Your mission

You'll be the first dedicated IT Administrator at Cosuno and the go-to person for all things IT for our 100-person team. From setting up laptops for new joiners to managing accounts and access in our SaaS tooling stack, you'll make sure everyone at Cosuno can simply sit down and work.

Today, IT support is handled on the side by our tech leadership. Your job is to take it over, put simple and reliable processes around it, and give our team an IT experience that just works.

What you'll do

Device management

  • Set up, maintain, repair, and replace laptops (Mac and Windows) for the whole company

  • Manage our device fleet through JumpCloud (MDM): enrollment, updates, configuration profiles, and security baselines

  • Keep our hardware inventory accurate and manage the lifecycle from purchase to secure disposal

Onboarding & offboarding

  • Run the IT side of joiner/mover/leaver processes: accounts, hardware, access rights, all ready on day one and cleanly removed on the last day

  • Continuously improve and automate these processes so they scale with the company

Accounts & SaaS administration

  • Administer user accounts, groups, and SSO across our SaaS stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and more)

  • Execute access requests and support periodic access reviews together with our Security team

IT support

  • Be the first point of contact for IT questions and problems, in the office and remotely

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, accounts, and connectivity issues, and document solutions so they're reusable

  • Support office IT: meeting room equipment, printers, WiFi, and event tech when needed

How we work

  • Ownership from day one: IT support is yours. You decide how to organize it, with the backing of our CTO and Security team.

  • Structure over firefighting: We'd rather you fix a problem once and automate or document it than fix it ten times. Building simple, self-service processes is part of the job.

  • AI as a daily tool: We use AI tools like Claude across the company, including in IT. Whether it's drafting documentation, writing a small script, or troubleshooting an unusual error, we expect you to use AI actively to work faster and smarter.

  • Close to Security: You'll work hand in hand with our Security & Compliance function. They define policies for devices and access; you put them into practice.

Your profile

You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • Fluent German and English. You'll support colleagues in both languages every day.

  • Hands-on experience in IT support or IT administration, ideally in a company running on Macs and SaaS tools

  • Experience with an MDM and/or identity provider (JumpCloud, Jamf, Kandji, Okta, Google Workspace, or similar), or the demonstrated ability to learn tools like these quickly

  • A service mindset. You're friendly, responsive, and patient, and you take pride in colleagues being unblocked quickly.

  • A structured way of working. You keep track of open tickets, document what you do, and follow through.

  • Comfort with light scripting or automation (shell, Python, or low-code tools), or the motivation to build this skill, ideally with AI assistance

Bonus points for:

  • Experience administering Google Workspace and Slack

  • Experience with hardware lifecycle management and IT asset inventory

  • Basic networking knowledge (WiFi, VPN, DNS)

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 or other security frameworks (access reviews, device compliance)

  • Experience in a fast-growing startup environment

Practical details

This role is based in Berlin with regular presence in our office, since a core part of the job is hands-on: setting up devices, helping colleagues in person, and keeping office IT running. Outside of that, we're flexible about hours and remote days.

Why us?

  • Real impact: You'll build the IT function of a Series C company from the ground up and shape how 100 people work every day.

  • Competitive compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

  • A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.

  • Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

Compensation: €45K – €60K

description_html:
Your mission

As a member of our Data team, you'll take full ownership of the systems that turn raw data into decisions—for our product, our internal teams, our customers, and our investors. You won't just maintain dashboards; you'll own the pipeline end to end, from ingestion to the numbers people actually act on.

In your first few months, you might:

  • Take ownership of our dbt pipeline, improving our data models so they're reliable, well-tested, and easy to build on.

  • Maintain and extend our Looker setup, and ship new dashboards and reports that customers and other stakeholders depend on.

  • Strengthen our data pipeline from Postgres to BigQuery, and build custom Python scripts to automate the flows that keep our warehouse fresh.

  • Integrate our data warehouse with external tools like Salesforce or ActiveCampaign, so the right data reaches the teams that need it.

How We Build: Our Engineering Culture

We believe in a calm, collaborative, and productive engineering environment. We trust our people and give them the autonomy to do their best work. Our approach includes:

  • Ownership Over Handoffs: On a small data team, you own your work from ingestion to dashboard. We trust you to make decisions and run with them.

  • Quality by Default: We treat our data models like production code—tested, version-controlled, and documented—so the numbers we serve are ones we can stand behind.

  • DevOps Mindset: We automate the boring parts. Pipelines, syncs, and checks are powered by third-party tools or GitHub Actions so the team can focus on the work that needs a human.

  • Collaboration & Transparency: We value open discussion, constructive reviews, and a culture where the best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from.

  • AI-Native by Default: We work heavily with Claude Code and other AI tools, and they're a core part of how we build—from writing models and scripts to debugging pipelines and exploring data. We expect everyone on the team to use them fluently and keep getting better at it.

Your profile

We're looking for an experienced data practitioner who likes owning the full stack of an analytics platform. You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • Significant professional experience building and maintaining data models with dbt and writing advanced SQL.

  • Solid Python skills for data syncing, automation, and general scripting.

  • Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, and comfort working with source databases like Postgres.

  • Experience building dashboards and serving data to non-technical stakeholders (a strong command of Looker is a big plus).

  • Strong, hands-on familiarity with AI coding tools—especially Claude Code—and a habit of using them as part of your daily workflow.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving and a high sense of ownership, feeling comfortable driving projects independently.

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

title: Technical Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Cosuno
description_html:
Your mission

The future of construction software isn't a single closed platform — it's a connected ecosystem. As our Technical Product Manager for Integrations, you'll own how Cosuno connects to the third-party systems our customers already rely on, from estimating and ERP tools like RIB iTWO to the open REST API that lets others build on top of us. You'll be the bridge between our customers, our engineers, and our platform — turning real-world integration needs into a roadmap that makes Cosuno the infrastructure the construction industry plugs into.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role in our Product team. Both our REST API and our connectors are still early, so you won't just maintain an integration surface — you'll shape it. You'll spend real time on-site with customers, understand how their systems actually work, and translate that into a product that lets them connect to Cosuno as seamlessly as possible.

In your first few months, you might:

  • Take ownership of our integrations product area — the REST API and our existing connectors to third-party systems such as RIB iTWO — and define where they go next.

  • Travel to customers across Germany to support them hands-on with implementing and setting up connectors, and to understand their systems, data flows, and constraints in the real world.

  • Sit down with customers to elicit integration requirements, then prioritize them against impact, effort, and our platform strategy.

  • Translate those requirements into clear, well-scoped tickets that our engineers can pick up and build — with the technical context they need to move fast.

  • Work through our API documentation and test endpoints yourself to validate what's possible, spot gaps, and represent the developer experience from the outside in.

  • Partner with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to make sure customers can connect their systems to Cosuno with as little friction as possible.

How we work

At Cosuno, we give people real ownership and trust them to do their best work. For this role, that means:

  • High autonomy, high impact: You'll own the integrations area end to end. No one will look over your shoulder, but you'll always have the support of the Product and Engineering teams when you need it.

  • Close to the customer: This is not a desk-only PM role. A meaningful part of your time is spent with customers on-site.

  • Technical by nature: You'll work directly with APIs, documentation, and connector behavior. You don't have to ship production code, but you do need to be comfortable in technical territory.

  • Platform thinking: We're building the infrastructure other construction tools and AI agents connect into. Every integration decision feeds that bigger picture.

  • AI-first: We use AI deeply in both our product and our daily work, and we want people who do the same.

Your profile

You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • 3–5 years of experience in product management, ideally in B2B SaaS, platform, or developer-facing products.

  • Hands-on experience with APIs and integrations — you understand how REST APIs work, can read and reason about API documentation, and are comfortable validating endpoints (e.g. with tools like Postman) yourself.

  • A talent for working directly with customers: eliciting requirements, asking the right questions, and earning trust in technical conversations.

  • The ability to translate messy, real-world integration needs into prioritized, well-scoped tickets that engineers can act on.

  • Strong analytical thinking and a pragmatic instinct for turning complex problems into workable solutions.

  • Fluent German (this is a firm requirement — all of our customers are German construction companies and you'll work with them directly and on-site) and fluent English.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to customers within Germany.

  • You use AI tools — LLM-based assistants, MCPs, no-code prototyping — routinely in your day-to-day work.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with construction tech, ERP, or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris).

  • A background as a solutions engineer, integration engineer, or technical consultant before or alongside product management.

Why us?

  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  • Work-Life Balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our modern office in Berlin Friedrichshain. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.

  • Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

  • A Great Team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.

  • Job Security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Growth & Feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

🇩🇪 Wir haben eine klare Mission: Wir bauen Europas führende Plattform für Energiemanagement, um faire und saubere Energie für alle zugänglich zu machen. ⚡

Unser Team ist vielfältig – wir sind über 50 Personen aus mehr als 16 Nationalitäten, mit einem Frauenanteil von 46 %. Und wir wachsen weiter!

Über Ostrom

Ostrom ist der digital-first Ökostromanbieter aus Berlin.   • Starkes Verständnis für Brand- und Performance-Marketing, mit Hands-on-Erfahrung in der kanalübergreifenden Steuerung, Optimierung und Erfolgsmessung

  • Sehr gutes wirtschaftliches Verständnis: Du denkst in Unit Economics, Margen und Customer Lifetime Value

Nice-to-Have

🌍 Work you way: Ob im Berliner Büro, im Homeoffice oder remote unter der Sonne – bei uns arbeitest du dort, wo du am produktivsten bist.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Finto
description_html:
About Finto

Finto is on a mission to reinvent how enterprises run their finance operations. Starting with AI-powered automation for accounts payable, we eliminate manual invoice handling, supplier chasing, 3-Way-Matching and ERP data entry. Backed by Y Combinator, we're building the future of enterprise accounting.

Our mission is to free the world's finance teams from repetitive, low-value tasks so they can focus on impactful work. That starts with building a place where everyone can do their best work. Whether you're building on our platform, partnering with our customers, or shaping our story: We just make things finance teams want.

About the role

We are hiring an Entrepreneur in Residence to work directly with our CTO. You will take ownership of important, loosely defined problems and deliver results.

Your initial focus will be customer integrations and solution engineering. You will lead strategic customer initiatives, translate recurring needs into product direction, and help reduce the time our CTO spends on solution scoping. As you prove ownership, your scope can expand into product discovery, internal engineering, or AI adoption.

This is a hands-on role. You will build, investigate, make decisions, and follow through. It is not a support or project-management position.

What you’ll do

Lead strategic customer initiatives

Own important customer engagements from discovery through delivery. Join technical conversations, clarify requirements, and act as the CTO’s delegate where agreed. Turn recurring customer needs into clear input for the product roadmap.

Drive product and technical discovery

Turn open questions into specifications and prototypes. Evaluate whether we should build, buy, or integrate. Research technical options and recommend a clear course of action.

Improve how our engineers work

Remove friction from onboarding, permissions, tooling, and internal infrastructure. Build secure, self-service workflows that help engineers work effectively.

Lead practical AI adoption

Test new AI tools and workflows across Finto. Measure whether they improve speed or quality, train the team on useful applications, and introduce appropriate guardrails.

Your priorities will change as the company changes. One week you may scope an ERP integration. The next, you may prototype a product idea or improve an internal workflow.

What we’re looking for

  • You have built something from scratch and taken responsibility for the outcome.

  • You are comfortable working through ambiguity without waiting for detailed instructions.

  • You can understand software architecture, build prototypes, and work with modern AI and LLM tools.

  • You are familiar with Node.js, TypeScript, and integration-heavy systems.

  • You have worked at startup speed, whether as a founder, early engineer, forward-deployed engineer, or in a Founder’s Office or Chief of Staff role.

  • You communicate clearly in German and English.

  • You want to take on more responsibility as you grow.

Experience with ERP integrations, fintech, developer tooling, or customer-facing technical work is helpful but not required.

Working at Finto

  • Work with the founders on problems that directly affect customers and the company.

  • Take ownership early. Your scope will grow with the results you deliver.

  • Join our in-office team in Munich five days per week.

  • Receive 25 vacation days and two company-wide recharge days.

  • Build relationships through Finto’s Y Combinator and San Francisco network.

Interview process

  1. Introductory call: 20 minutes with our CEO

  2. Technical call: 30 minutes with our CTO

  3. Working session: 90-minute technical challenge

  4. Culture interview with our CPO

  5. Meet the team

  6. Offer

Compensation: €60K – €80K • Offers Equity

title: SAP Integration Architect

description_html:
About the role

We are looking for an SAP Integration Architect to own how Finto connects to SAP. Some of our customers run their finance operations on SAP, and no two landscapes look alike: R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, on-premise and cloud, Business One and Business ByDesign. You'll design how master data, invoices and postings move between those systems and our AI platform, and turn what starts as a bespoke integration into a product that goes live in weeks. This is a hands-on role, working directly with our CTO and the founding team: you'll set the architecture, write code, and sit across the table from customer IT. You're the first hire dedicated to SAP at Finto and you define what the practice becomes. We're headquartered in Munich, with roots in San Francisco through Y Combinator.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture from a customer's SAP system into Finto: master data, invoices, postings, write-back.

  • Choose the integration path per SAP flavour - OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI, file-based - and make that choice repeatable instead of re-deciding it per customer.

  • Build the connector platform: templates, validation, monitoring, and the tooling that makes every new landscape faster than the last.

  • Translate FI and MM process knowledge into specifications and field mappings our engineers build against.

  • Ship production code with the engineering team - same repo, same reviews, Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Be the SAP authority in the room: with customer IT, with their integration partners, and in our own technical conversations with prospects.

  • Set the standard for how Finto goes live on SAP, and move more of it into the product with every rollout.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of hands-on SAP integration work in real customer landscapes across R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, ideally more than one generation of them.

  • Deep knowledge of the accounts payable process in SAP: FI, MM, the document flow around incoming invoices, tax determination, and why the field a customer means is rarely the field the label says.

  • Fluency across SAP's integration surface - OData, IDocs, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI - and a clear position on clean core.

  • Strong coding skills, ideally in TypeScript/Node.js. You architect and you build; specifications alone aren't the job.

  • A product instinct: you'd rather build a pattern once than map the same fields twice.

  • Confidence in front of enterprise IT teams, and the directness to tell them when an export won't work.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • Bonus points for ABAP, for time on the consulting side of SAP rollouts, or for anything you've built that made your own job smaller.

Work at Finto

  • An environment where we enable you to have an impact and where we focus on outcomes, not time-tracking.

  • Career-defining growth: Big ambitions mean rapid progression, expanding responsibilities, and access to our San Francisco & YC network.

  • Shape your future role: As an early team member, you define what SAP at Finto looks like, and grow it into a team.

  • Real enterprise SAP landscapes from week one, not a sandbox.

  • 25 vacation days + 2 fixed "company recharge days."

  • A vibrant in-office culture (5 days/week) in a modern office.

Interview Process

  1. Intro - 20 mins with our CEO

  2. Technical Get to Know - 30 mins with our CTO

  3. Challenge - 60 mins architecture & design challenge on a real SAP landscape

  4. Culture call with our CPO

  5. Meet the team

  6. Offer

Compensation: €70K – €130K • Offers Equity

What We’re Building Towards

title: IT Administrator
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Cosuno
description_html:
Your mission

You'll be the first dedicated IT Administrator at Cosuno and the go-to person for all things IT for our 100-person team. From setting up laptops for new joiners to managing accounts and access in our SaaS tooling stack, you'll make sure everyone at Cosuno can simply sit down and work.

Today, IT support is handled on the side by our tech leadership. Your job is to take it over, put simple and reliable processes around it, and give our team an IT experience that just works.

What you'll do

Device management

  • Set up, maintain, repair, and replace laptops (Mac and Windows) for the whole company

  • Manage our device fleet through JumpCloud (MDM): enrollment, updates, configuration profiles, and security baselines

  • Keep our hardware inventory accurate and manage the lifecycle from purchase to secure disposal

Onboarding & offboarding

  • Run the IT side of joiner/mover/leaver processes: accounts, hardware, access rights, all ready on day one and cleanly removed on the last day

  • Continuously improve and automate these processes so they scale with the company

Accounts & SaaS administration

  • Administer user accounts, groups, and SSO across our SaaS stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and more)

  • Execute access requests and support periodic access reviews together with our Security team

IT support

  • Be the first point of contact for IT questions and problems, in the office and remotely

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, accounts, and connectivity issues, and document solutions so they're reusable

  • Support office IT: meeting room equipment, printers, WiFi, and event tech when needed

How we work

  • Ownership from day one: IT support is yours. You decide how to organize it, with the backing of our CTO and Security team.

  • Structure over firefighting: We'd rather you fix a problem once and automate or document it than fix it ten times. Building simple, self-service processes is part of the job.

  • AI as a daily tool: We use AI tools like Claude across the company, including in IT. Whether it's drafting documentation, writing a small script, or troubleshooting an unusual error, we expect you to use AI actively to work faster and smarter.

  • Close to Security: You'll work hand in hand with our Security & Compliance function. They define policies for devices and access; you put them into practice.

Your profile

You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • Fluent German and English. You'll support colleagues in both languages every day.

  • Hands-on experience in IT support or IT administration, ideally in a company running on Macs and SaaS tools

  • Experience with an MDM and/or identity provider (JumpCloud, Jamf, Kandji, Okta, Google Workspace, or similar), or the demonstrated ability to learn tools like these quickly

  • A service mindset. You're friendly, responsive, and patient, and you take pride in colleagues being unblocked quickly.

  • A structured way of working. You keep track of open tickets, document what you do, and follow through.

  • Comfort with light scripting or automation (shell, Python, or low-code tools), or the motivation to build this skill, ideally with AI assistance

Bonus points for:

  • Experience administering Google Workspace and Slack

  • Experience with hardware lifecycle management and IT asset inventory

  • Basic networking knowledge (WiFi, VPN, DNS)

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 or other security frameworks (access reviews, device compliance)

  • Experience in a fast-growing startup environment

Practical details

This role is based in Berlin with regular presence in our office, since a core part of the job is hands-on: setting up devices, helping colleagues in person, and keeping office IT running. Outside of that, we're flexible about hours and remote days.

Why us?

  • Real impact: You'll build the IT function of a Series C company from the ground up and shape how 100 people work every day.

  • Competitive compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

  • A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.

  • Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

Compensation: €45K – €60K

As our Technical Product Manager for Integrations, you'll own how Cosuno connects to the third-party systems our customers already rely on, from estimating and ERP tools like RIB iTWO to the open REST API that lets others build on top of us. You'll be the bridge between our customers, our engineers, and our platform — turning real-world integration needs into a roadmap that makes Cosuno the infrastructure the construction industry plugs into.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role in our Product team. Both our REST API and our connectors are still early, so you won't just maintain an integration surface — you'll shape it. You'll spend real time on-site with customers, understand how their systems actually work, and translate that into a product that lets them connect to Cosuno as seamlessly as possible.

In your first few months, you might:

  • Take ownership of our integrations product area — the REST API and our existing connectors to third-party systems such as RIB iTWO — and define where they go next.

  • Travel to customers across Germany to support them hands-on with implementing and setting up connectors, and to understand their systems, data flows, and constraints in the real world.

  • Sit down with customers to elicit integration requirements, then prioritize them against impact, effort, and our platform strategy.

  • Translate those requirements into clear, well-scoped tickets that our engineers can pick up and build — with the technical context they need to move fast.

  • Work through our API documentation and test endpoints yourself to validate what's possible, spot gaps, and represent the developer experience from the outside in.

  • Partner with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to make sure customers can connect their systems to Cosuno with as little friction as possible.

How we work

At Cosuno, we give people real ownership and trust them to do their best work. For this role, that means:

  • High autonomy, high impact: You'll own the integrations area end to end. No one will look over your shoulder, but you'll always have the support of the Product and Engineering teams when you need it.

  • Close to the customer: This is not a desk-only PM role. A meaningful part of your time is spent with customers on-site.

  • Technical by nature: You'll work directly with APIs, documentation, and connector behavior. You don't have to ship production code, but you do need to be comfortable in technical territory.

  • Platform thinking: We're building the infrastructure other construction tools and AI agents connect into. Every integration decision feeds that bigger picture.

  • AI-first: We use AI deeply in both our product and our daily work, and we want people who do the same.

Your profile

You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • 3–5 years of experience in product management, ideally in B2B SaaS, platform, or developer-facing products.

  • Hands-on experience with APIs and integrations — you understand how REST APIs work, can read and reason about API documentation, and are comfortable validating endpoints (e.g. with tools like Postman) yourself.

  • A talent for working directly with customers: eliciting requirements, asking the right questions, and earning trust in technical conversations.

  • The ability to translate messy, real-world integration needs into prioritized, well-scoped tickets that engineers can act on.

  • Strong analytical thinking and a pragmatic instinct for turning complex problems into workable solutions.

  • Fluent German (this is a firm requirement — all of our customers are German construction companies and you'll work with them directly and on-site) and fluent English.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to customers within Germany.

  • You use AI tools — LLM-based assistants, MCPs, no-code prototyping — routinely in your day-to-day work.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with construction tech, ERP, or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris).

  • A background as a solutions engineer, integration engineer, or technical consultant before or alongside product management.

Why us?

  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  • Work-Life Balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our modern office in Berlin Friedrichshain. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.

  • Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

  • A Great Team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.

  • Job Security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Growth & Feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

description_html:
About the Team

We are hiring a Partnerships Manager based in Germany with primary responsibility for Germany. You will own some of OpenAI’s most important business development and partnerships in the German market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities. The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing partnership strategies that accelerate adoption of OpenAI’s products across enterprise, developer, and consumer channels.

About the Role

You will manage relationships with strategic partners in Germany and on cross-border opportunities, ranging from global technology platforms to regional champions, including enterprise software vendors, telcos, cloud providers, and government-aligned organizations. This is a deeply cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, and Policy teams. Although the role has clear accountability for Germany, team priorities may evolve, so you must be ready to take on other markets, verticals, or partnership types.

Please note that this role is based out of our Munich office, with 3 days a week required in the office.

In this role, you will:

  • Own partnership strategy and execution for Germany, driving end-to-end partnership development and delivery in the market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities.

  • Negotiate and close strategic local and cross-border deals across commercial terms, product scope, data/privacy, brand/marketing, incentives, and expansion paths.

  • Lead senior partner relationships: build trust, align on joint value props, and manage complexity.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, Policy, and regional counterparts to align roadmaps, navigate constraints, and execute partnership initiatives.

  • Bring deep knowledge of Germany and a strong point of view on country and sub-region differences across EMEA, informing prioritization, positioning, and partner selection. Apply that judgment flexibly when supporting opportunities beyond Germany or in new verticals.

  • Define success metrics and use analytical judgment to assess progress, surface risks, and communicate outcomes to internal stakeholders.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, product partnerships, business development, or general management within the technology industry.

  • Fluency in English and German.

  • Demonstrated success leading high-impact local and international partnerships involving major technology partners, including complex cross-border work.

  • Deep understanding of the German market, combined with experience operating across multiple countries and international markets.

  • Product-savvy with the ability to engage technical stakeholders credibly and influence product direction and roadmap tradeoffs.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presence.

  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to inform decisions and communicate impact.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly ambiguous environment, operate both independently and collaboratively, and adapt quickly across changing markets, verticals, and partnership types.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Security Engineer (Full Remote - Germany)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at EverAI
description_html:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

As a Security Engineer, you will take ownership of protecting our product, our users, and our collaborators as we scale a fast-growing AI companionship platform. You'll work hands-on across application security, risk & compliance, and security awareness (plus keeping an eye on AI-specific threats as our product line evolves). Given the nature of our product (AI-generated content, including NSFW) you'll play a key role in keeping both our systems and our users safe, with real ownership from day one.

This is a hands-on role reporting directly to the Security Lead, with regular check-ins on priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Application Security

  • Perform weekly code reviews to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

  • Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of security vulnerabilities across the stack

  • Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests, and follow through on findings

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

  • Maintain and evolve our risk register, mapping all company services and prioritizing what's exposed

  • Support audit follow-up and keep GRC documentation up to date

Security Awareness

  • Communicate new threats to the team, document findings, and broadcast security updates company-wide

  • Run phishing simulations and security training (via Riot)

Monitoring & Coverage

  • Own the monitoring of security channels and alerts, including weekend coverage, so nothing goes unanswered

IT & Access Management

  • Set up and secure new employee devices (MDM), manage access provisioning/deprovisioning

AI Security Monitoring

  • Keep an eye on emerging attack techniques targeting generative AI (prompt injection, jailbreaks, content filter bypass)

  • Track security incidents and vulnerabilities disclosed by the third-party AI providers we rely on

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • Solid experience in application security (code review, vulnerability management)

  • Experience coordinating or conducting penetration tests / security audits

  • Comfortable shipping code and working with Git/GitHub workflows

  • Scripting/automation skills

  • Bonus: familiarity with AI/LLM security concepts (prompt injection, jailbreaking, adversarial testing) — this is still an emerging field, so curiosity matters more than proven experience

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🧢 Goal-orientated, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - you are comfortable working in an environment with products that are based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Cursor, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

* 💸 Compensation: Our salary ranges are set based on role level, scope, location, and market data, and applied consistently regardless of candidate background or negotiation history. The final offer within the published range reflects assessed experience and scope.

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: €65K – €115K • Multiple Ranges

  • Mid • Estimated Base Salary €65K – €85K
  • Senior • Estimated Base Salary €85K – €115K

description_html:
At our company, it’s all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH.

Our Tech Stack 🚀

· OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go
· FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling

Your Role

You will help us build, operate and industrialize OVHcloud's on-premise cloud platform. As part of a small, senior team, you will work on our OpenStack-based infrastructure and the Kubernetes / GitOps stack powering our customer-facing cloud. AI-assisted engineering is a first-class part of how we work – from spec-driven development and agentic coding workflows to incident response and automation. The platform is in active development, giving you real influence on the architecture, automation strategy and how we adopt AI in platform engineering. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and shape your focus based on your strengths, with a clear backbone of automation, compute lifecycle, platform engineering and AI substrate work.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design and build our OpenStack-based on-premise cloud infrastructure, with the goal of bringing complete cloud environments from bare metal to production through a highly automated deployment process.

  • Develop and operate Infrastructure as Code with Ansible and Terraform as well as our Kubernetes and GitOps workflows using FluxCD / ArgoCD, supported by LLMs, agentic workflows and automated testing and review.

  • Own the lifecycle of our compute infrastructure – from bare metal, firmware and provisioning through to hypervisors and virtual compute nodes. This includes patching, migrations, host evacuation, capacity rebalancing and the automation required to keep the platform healthy.

  • Build and extend our AI substrate and self-healing capabilities, from structured knowledge bases and agentic workflows for incident triage and capacity planning to gradually turning today's manual runbooks into automated processes.

  • Design tests for non-regression, performance and security, document and package solutions, and continuously improve the platform based on telemetry, operational experience and user feedback.

  • Act as a technical reference and sparring partner for peers across automation, platform engineering and AI tooling.

What we offer you

  • A platform genuinely in build mode, with real room to shape architectural decisions, strong ownership and a senior team where autonomy matters.

  • AI-augmented engineering as a first-class workflow - including Claude Code and comparable agentic tooling, Markdown-based knowledge bases and room to push our engineering practices further.

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam.

  • Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies.

  • 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service.

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation.

  • Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package.

  • OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs.

  • Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities, such as gym memberships or sports classes.

  • Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies.

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike.

  • Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages.


  • Several years of hands-on experience as an SRE, Platform Engineer or DevOps Engineer running production infrastructure, with strong experience in OpenStack, Kubernetes and Linux, including bare metal.

  • You have managed compute infrastructure end-to-end, from firmware / BIOS rollouts, bare-metal provisioning and hardware diagnostics to hypervisors, migrations, host evacuation, graceful drains and capacity rebalancing.

  • AI-assisted engineering is already part of your daily work. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they meaningfully support development, testing, reviews, or operations, and you know where AI adds real value and where strong engineering expertise remains essential.

  • You are confident working with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps workflows such as FluxCD or ArgoCD and understand what it takes to turn automation into robust, repeatable production systems.

  • Ideally, you write Go and/or Python and have experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Aider or comparable agentic coding environments. Exposure to observability, networking, compute tuning, auto-remediation, security-critical infrastructure or multi-site clouds is also a plus.

  • You work autonomously, bring a strong sense of ownership and enjoy improving systems rather than simply keeping them running. You also enjoy sharing knowledge and can communicate complex technical topics clearly.

  • You are fluent in English, written and spoken. English is the working language of our distributed team.

  • Eine Plattform im echten Build Mode mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, sichtbarem Einfluss auf Architekturentscheidungen und einem erfahrenen Senior-Team, in dem Autonomie und Ownership zählen.

  • Wir arbeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld auf Englisch. Du fühlst dich deshalb sicher dabei, technische Themen auf Englisch zu diskutieren, zu dokumentieren und gemeinsam im Team voranzutreiben.

description_html:
Position description

 
At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Machine Learning Scientist to join our Data & AI team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis engine. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) techniques to the complex domain of source code. Your work will directly shape our products, pushing the boundaries of static analysis to help millions of developers write better, more secure code. If you are driven to solve real-world problems by turning state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you.
 

What you will do
  • Spearhead Research & Innovation: Stay on the cutting edge of ML, Deep Learning, and LLMs, specifically their application to the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), and identify novel opportunities to enhance our products.
  • Develop Advanced AI Models: Design, prototype, and validate novel ML models that identify and resolve complex bugs, vulnerabilities, and code smells, going beyond the capabilities of traditional static analysis.
  • Build LLM-Powered Features: Develop and implement advanced LLM-based solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for contextual code analysis, fine-tuning models on proprietary codebases, and exploring agentic systems for automated code remediation.
  • Engineer Data Pipelines: Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale.
  • Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful ML prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base.
  • Communicate and Evangelize: Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Experience and qualifications
  • An advanced academic background (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.
