title: Senior Backend Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at TYTAN Technologies GmbH
description_html:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We thrive, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who thrive on ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are looking for a new team member who is eager to make a real difference! As a Senior Full-Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing and developing scalable military ground control station applications coordinating various effectors and integrating with external systems in real-time mission-critical environments.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Own the backend and integration layer for ground systems the services connecting operator tools, vehicles, sensors, and mission infrastructure

  • Design event-driven architectures and durable interface contracts so frontend, embedded, and partner systems can integrate and evolve safely

  • Build software that holds up in real operations, from telemetry pipelines to deployment, and follow problems across service boundaries end to end (including occasional lab or field support)

  • Raise engineering standards through design, code review, and mentoring, working closely with frontend, embedded, and guidance/navigation/control engineers


We care more about strong software engineers than checkbox perfection. If you meet most of these and are motivated to grow into the rest, please still apply tell us where you are strong and where you would ramp up.

Technical skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience, plus 5+ years of commercial backend/platform development (no mission-domain background required)

  • Strong Python skills, it's the primary language for integration work on this team

  • Experience with service design, event-driven systems, async messaging, and evolving APIs without breaking consumers

  • Hands-on experience with contract-first interfaces: OpenAPI and Protocol Buffers

  • Track record building production APIs and real-time channels (REST, WebSockets, pub-sub)

  • Practical understanding of latency and performance trade-offs in system design

  • Comfortable with PostgreSQL, Redis, and choosing the right tool for the workload

  • Experience on Linux with Docker and CI/CD, with a solid grasp of HTTP servers and reverse proxies

  • Hands-on observability skills: structured logging, metrics, and production experience with Prometheus/Grafana

Soft Skills

  • Comfortable working in Scrum or similar agile teams

  • Strong software craftsmanship: testing, debugging distributed issues, code review, and clear communication in English (German a plus)

  • Ownership mindset, you follow problems across service boundaries and take responsibility for making integrations work end to end

Nice to Have

  • ROS 2 experience (nodes, topics, services) and familiarity with DDS/QoS

  • Deeper networking knowledge (TCP/IP, UDP, sockets) or hands-on work with Nginx/HAProxy

  • Time-series databases (e.g. InfluxDB) for high-frequency telemetry

  • Additional languages such as TypeScript/Node, Go, or C++

  • Familiarity with MAVLink or similar vehicle/telemetry protocols

  • Prior work in robotics, autonomous systems, defense, or industrial control software

  • Tech-lead or mentoring experience

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site integration and test campaigns

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Full Stack Engineer to join our Platform Team. In this role you build and own the internal software our engineers and production teams rely on every day: the applications that track what runs on every system we build, support our manufacturing and test processes, and turn operational data into better products. This is not a customer-facing web role: your users sit in the same building, and the tools you build directly determine how fast we can build, test and deliver.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Design, build and own internal web applications end to end, covering frontend, backend, data model and deployment

  • Develop tooling that supports our manufacturing, where clarity and correctness in the user interface directly affect hardware outcomes

  • Build and maintain the configuration and traceability applications that connect our engineering, production and business systems into one coherent chain

  • Extend our ML and data tooling so that operational data flows reliably from the field into datasets, models and back into our systems

  • Integrate heterogeneous systems (PLM, ERP, version control, device fleet, data platform) through robust APIs and clean interfaces

  • Work directly with the engineers, operators and test teams who use your software, and translate their day-to-day problems into simple, durable solutions

  • Take ownership of the reliability of what you build, as these applications are part of our production and development critical path


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field

  • 4+ years of professional experience building and operating production web applications, with clear depth in at least one half of the stack and solid competence in the other

  • Strong backend engineering in a modern language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, C#, Go, TypeScript/Node or comparable. We care more about engineering strength than about prior exposure to a specific language, and expect strong engineers to pick up an unfamiliar stack quickly

  • Practical frontend experience with a component-based framework (React, Angular, Vue or similar) and the judgement to design an interface that people can use under time pressure

  • Sound relational data modelling and practical experience with relational databases

  • Confident with containerisation, version control workflows and CI/CD; able to deploy, monitor and debug your own services

  • Proven ownership of an internal tool or platform: gathering requirements from colleagues, scoping them realistically, and maintaining the result over time

  • A pragmatic engineer who builds robustly where correctness matters and deliberately simply everywhere else

  • Structured problem solver with a hands-on mindset and a bias toward shipping

  • Eager to work closely with a multidisciplinary team of software, hardware, production and flight test engineers

  • Fluent in English, German is beneficial

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with manufacturing, MES, PLM or ERP systems, or with software used on a production floor

  • Background in robotics, automotive, aerospace or other hardware-related engineering environments

  • Experience with data pipelines, data versioning or MLOps tooling

  • Working knowledge of container orchestration and infrastructure-as-code

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

title: Working Student Software Engineering (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ginmon GmbH
description_html:
Are you a Bachelor’s or Master’s student in the Rhein-Main area who is passionate about shaping the financial world of tomorrow and eager to level up your skills by working on real projects in a modern FinTech environment?

Then Ginmon is the right place for you!

We are an innovative FinTech company focused on digital wealth management based on scientifically proven ETF investment strategies. Our technical platform provides private investors, partner banks and financial institutions with efficient, transparent and professional access to asset management.

Driven by our growth ambitions and supported by an international team of financial experts, tech enthusiasts, and startup pioneers, we share one common mission: helping our clients achieve their financial goals efficiently, transparently, and scientifically.

As a Working Student in Software Engineering (m/f/d), you bring curiosity, initiative, and a strong sense of responsibility to contribute to the financial technologies of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

  • Actively contribute to the Ginmon codebase and deliver real value to our users through clean, scalable, and well-tested code;

  • Support backend components of our automated asset management solution;

  • Enforce best practices by communicating with team members and holding each other accountable;

  • Support the teams developing the products and services built on the shared infrastructure.


Your Profile:

  • You are currently enrolled as a Bachelor’s or Master’s student at a university in the Rhein-Main area, with at least two semesters remaining before graduation, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related field;

  • Knowledge in programming. Ideally, you already have knowledge of one or more of the following technologies or tools: AWS Lambda / Quarqus / JOOQ / MySQL;

  • You are eager to gain real-world insights into entrepreneurial practice and actively contribute to innovative digital solutions;

  • You have good communication skills and are fluent in English;

  • Ideally, you are based near Frankfurt am Main, as occasional on-site collaboration with the Product Development team is required.

Why Ginmon?

  • With us, you can bring about change directly and realise your ideas in a flat hierarchy. Your input counts and you have the opportunity to put your ideas into practice.

  • With a lot of responsibility and a steep learning curve, we have already helped many working students get off to a good start in their careers. You will be entrusted with challenging tasks and experience rapid development.

  • Working at Ginmon means having fun and being successful at the same time. We promote a positive working environment where fun and success go hand in hand.

  • You will benefit from our market-leading product that offers real added value to our customers. Our innovative solutions help investors achieve their financial goals efficiently.

  • Enjoy a relaxed working atmosphere with free drinks, snacks and regular team events.

  • We offer special employee conditions and a variety of other attractive benefits.


    Do you want to join our team? Then apply now and actively shape the future of the financial world!

title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bliq
description_html:
Your mission

At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

Responsibilities

  • Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets

  • Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria

  • Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation

  • Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan

  • Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams

  • Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders

  • Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors

  • Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them

  • Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate

  • Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes

  • Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully

  • Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe

  • Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy

  • Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions



Your profile

Apply if this describes you:

  • You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience

  • You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand

  • You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon

  • You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product

  • You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

  • You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal

  • You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost

  • You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes

  • Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus

  • You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own

  • You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem

  • You are comfortable owning a market or commercial project and being measured by the outcome

  • You can work professionally in German and English; additional European languages are a plus

  • You are based in Berlin

  • You are willing to travel regularly across Europe

  • Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus

This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next.

It will suit you if you want to help create a category, sell something people can experience in the real world, and build the commercial machine while running it.


Why us?

  • Sell a product people are excited about

  • Build Bliq’s sales playbook together with the Commercial Lead

  • Work directly with the founders and senior team

  • Own meaningful customer relationships and markets from an early stage

  • Work on complex deals combining technology, vehicles, operations, economics, and regulation

  • See deals move from your first message to vehicles operating on public roads with the customer

  • Fast decisions, direct feedback, and no bureaucracy

  • Strong compensation package with meaningful upside for performance

  • Significant room to grow as Bliq expands across European markets

Tips for a successful application

  1. Show us that you can sell. Generic applications tell us very little.

  2. Tell us what you have personally owned and what results you produced.

  3. If you have built pipeline, opened a new market, sold a difficult product, or closed an unusual deal, tell us how.

  4. Use AI as a tool. Make sure the thinking and personality in your application are yours.

title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Wandelbots GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.

The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.
The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. 
E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.

You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

  • Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

  • Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA- and NGC-based workloads

  • Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

  • Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

description_html:
Description:

Looking for an employer you can count on? Join us!

 

Data Platform Engineer (f/m/d) for the European AI Factory HammerHAI


Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • Developing and maintaining the data facility of the AI Factory including its software environments in the context of AI, HPC and data analytics use cases for modern AI, high-performance and cloud computing systems
  • Contributing to the initial (and evolving) service portfolio of the AI Factory within a friendly and open work environment in a highly motivated, international team with opportunities to contribute with your own ideas
  • Supporting and enabling customers to publish, access and share their own AI data sets and models
  • Fostering contact with collaboration partners as well as stakeholders from the European AI ecosystem, relying on your friendly personality and communication skills
  • Opportunities to work with national and European partners on novel AI R&D projects from the private and academic sectors
  • Maintaining relationships with technology providers and system developers (software/hardware)


Your Qualifications:

Required/Minimum Qualifications

 

  • PhD or Master’s degree in computer or data science, or other areas of scientific computing, or a Bachelor’s degree with multiple years (>3) of applied data platform development / engineering / deployment experience and/or working with AI data management workflows ideally as senior engineer in research or enterprise environments 

 

Other Requirements

  • Proficiency working in data center environments (incl. Linux, Git, Gitlab)
  • Willingness to keep up with current developments and to learn new technologies in the field of AI
  • Extensive knowledge and experience in developing and working with data platforms including their backend components in the context of AI, HPC and data analytics use cases (preferably piveau, www.piveau.de)
  • Extensive knowledge about and practical skills in specifying and implementing FAIR-aligned (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) data management workflows
  • Knowledge and experience in developing integration layers for connecting data infrastructure with external data platforms, preferably through metadata standards
  • Knowledge about and practical skills in secure and compliant data management, including AI models as well as data privacy standards and legislation
  • Excellent English and preferably German presentation and writing skills
 

Additional and Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge and experience with dataspaces, ideally within the Common European Data Space initiative
  • Knowledge and experience in software deployment and software lifecycle management (ideally based on principles of continuous integration/continuous deployment, CI/CD)
  • Basic knowledge and practical skills in software design and engineering
  • Basic knowledge and practical skills in IT and cybersecurity for software and software platform development
  • Experience with agile development methods


Conditions:

Working time

full time (40 hrs) / part-time possible

flexible working model with electronic time recording

Contract duration

End of Q1/2028, further employment is intended

Remuneration

up to E 13, see Entgelttabelle TV-L

Annual leave /                   compensatory time off

30 days 

(24.12. + 31.12. additionally day off)

Overtime is compensated by additional time off

Benefits

Up to 60% mobile work for suitable tasks, mostly two-person offices, bus and subway (U6) on the doorstep, free parking, pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL), state-of-the-art work equipment, Cooperation Agreement with Sports Facility Providers for Discounted Membership


What you can expect at LRZ:

Are you looking for a multifaceted and intellectually stimulating position in a dynamic, cooperative and innovative work environment? Then LRZ is the place to be for you! Here at LRZ a collegial, appreciative work environment meets an international crowd of experts who work together to advance IT services for ground-breaking research. We offer flexible work schemes for an optimal work-life balance. Our staff values their creative leeway. As an institute of the Bavarian Academy of Science and Humanities we offer all the benefits of public service. And of course, no wishes remain unfulfilled at the LRZ in terms of technical equipment. We share experiences, constantly review and improve our processes, and are proud that our service-quality and data-security are regularly certified and rated highly. We actively promote diversity and welcome applications from talented individuals, regardless of cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, gender and sexual identity, physical abilities, religion and age. We give priority to applications from people with disabilities who are equally qualified (SGB IX). 


Further information:

We are looking forward to receiving your complete application documents (including cover letter, CV and certificates) in a PDF file (other file types are not accepted) by latest 12.10.2026.

 

Subject: Data Management Expert (2026/46)

 

Are you unsure whether the job suits you or you suit us? Or do you still have questions about this position? Our colleagues will be happy to answer all your questions. 
This job does not fit? Then take a look at https://www.lrz.de/en/careers/current-vacancies or send us an unsolicited application!

title: Customer Success Expert (m/f/d) for the European AI Factory HammerHAI

description_html:
Description:

Looking for an employer you can count on? Join us!

 

Customer Success Expert (m/f/d) for the European AI Factory HammerHAI


Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers, as well as new and existing clients, closely working with a team of support staff starting from onboarding to ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes using service offers of the European AI Factory (AIF) HammerHAI
  • Document the user journeys of the AIFs customers and utilise CRM tools to track customer interactions and pipeline progress
  • (Co-)organise and contribute to events (e.g. conferences, workshops, and hackathons) for existing customers and outreach events to win new customers from AIF's target customer groups
  • Introduce services and technologies available through HammerHAI to customers and potential clients
  • Conduct regular business reviews to assess customer health satisfaction, proactively identifying new opportunities to expand the interaction with customers and co-develop business development strategies
  • Collaborate with other roles in the AI Factory to convey customer needs and create targeted campaigns that enhance customer engagement and brand loyalty
  • Optimize the value customers derive from HammerHAI's service offers and to help customers optimising their service utilisation
  • Manage the full end-to-end user interaction and engagement cycle, from prospecting to closing, and supporting technical discussions with customers and presentations


Your Qualifications:

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  • Master of Business Administration (MBA), or a similar degree (e.g in management, marketing or communications) with 2 years of work experience or a Bachelor in these disciplines with multiple years (>4) of work experience, in roles which cover a significant fraction of the job profile described above

 

Other Requirements

  • Ambition to further shape the AIF’s structures as part of a highly motivated team
  • Knowledge and experience in working with and organising customer relationship management (CRM), including proficiency in CRM platforms for managing customer data and sales pipelines
  • Excellent English and German communication skills — both verbal and written — to effectively convey value propositions and excellent collaboration skills to work effectively with both, internal teams and international customers
  • Willingness to keep up with current developments and to learn about development of new technologies in the field of AI
  • Ability to develop and execute strategic account plans to maximize customer lifetime value
  • Ability to quickly learn and effectively communicate the value of HammerHAI service solutions
 

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in working at or with start-ups and/or small and medium enterprises (SMEs), together with strong negotiation abilities with a focus on building lasting client relationships
  • Proven experience in business development, B2B sales, and account management
  • Expertise in marketing strategies related to customer engagement and retention
  • Knowledge of technology sales, including technical sales processes and solutions
  • Analytical skills to interpret data for strategic decision-making
  • Experience in warm calling techniques to generate new leads and nurture existing accounts
  • Experience contributing to customer onboarding processes
  • Executing and contributing to process playbooks
  • Demonstrated experience in driving revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and renewals
  • Proficiency in analyzing customer data and providing data-driven recommendations


Conditions:

Working time

full time (40 hrs) / part-time possible

flexible working model with electronic time recording

Contract duration

End of Q1/2028, further employment is intended

Remuneration

up to E 13, see Entgelttabelle TV-L

Annual leave /                   compensatory time off

30 days 

(24.12. + 31.12. additionally day off)

Overtime is compensated by additional time off

Benefits

Up to 60% mobile work for suitable tasks, mostly two-person offices, bus and subway (U6) on the doorstep, free parking, pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL), state-of-the-art work equipment, Cooperation Agreement with Sports Facility Providers for Discounted Membership


What you can expect at LRZ:

Are you looking for a multifaceted and intellectually stimulating position in a dynamic, cooperative and innovative work environment? Then LRZ is the place to be for you! Here at LRZ a collegial, appreciative work environment meets an international crowd of experts who work together to advance IT services for ground-breaking research. We offer flexible work schemes for an optimal work-life balance. Our staff values their creative leeway. As an institute of the Bavarian Academy of Science and Humanities we offer all the benefits of public service. And of course, no wishes remain unfulfilled at the LRZ in terms of technical equipment. We share experiences, constantly review and improve our processes, and are proud that our service-quality and data-security are regularly certified and rated highly. We actively promote diversity and welcome applications from talented individuals, regardless of cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, gender and sexual identity, physical abilities, religion and age. We give priority to applications from people with disabilities who are equally qualified (SGB IX).

description_html:
Beschreibung:

Das Leibniz-Rechenzentrum (LRZ) betreibt auf Basis von Atlassian Confluence eine bayernweite Plattform zur hochschulübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit in Wissenschaft und Forschung. Zur Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer Kollaborationsplattform BayernCollab sowie der zugehörigen Management-Oberfläche und für die Administration der Instanz suchen wir dich als:
 
Systemadministratorin (m/w/d) Administration und Weiterentwicklung von Enterprise Wiki-Lösungen


Das sind deine Aufgaben:

  • Betrieb und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung einer mandantenfähigen Kollaborationslösung auf Basis von Atlassian Confluence Datacenter am LRZ
  • 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support für unsere Plattform
  • Erstellung und Pflege der Betriebsdokumentation
  • Ansprechpartner für Kunden bei Fragen und Problemen
  • Evaluation alternativer Wiki-Systeme zur strategischen Weiterentwicklung der Kollaborationsplattform
  • Arbeiten in einem Umfeld mit zertifizierten, transparenten Prozessen für Qualität und Nachvollziehbarkeit
  • zertifizierte, transparente Prozesse


Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor) in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbarem Studiengang
  • Kenntnisse in der Administration von Windows-Serversystemen
  • Kenntnisse in der Administration von Linux-Serversystemen (Debian)
  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrungen mit Datenbanken
  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrungen im Aufbau und Betrieb von Atlassian Confluence
  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit Kubernetes und Containerisierung
  • Sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (Level C)
  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten und Teamorientierung
  • Gute Auffassungsgabe sowie selbstständige, kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Bereitschaft, Erfahrungen zu teilen und Prozesse kritisch zu hinterfragen, um Verbesserungen im Team voranzutreiben
  • Du teilst gerne Erfahrungen und stellst Abläufe auf den Prüfstand, um sie im Team zu verbessern. 
Natürlich bieten wir für Berufsanfängerinnen und Wiedereinsteigerinnen eine fundierte Einarbeitung.


Das ist unser Angebot:

Arbeitszeit

Vollzeit (40 Std) / Teilzeit möglich

Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell mit elektronischer

Zeiterfassung

Vertragsdauer 

31.12.2028, Weiterbeschäftigung wird angestrebt

Vergütung

möglich bis E 11, siehe Entgelttabelle TV-L 

Urlaub/Freizeit

30 Tage bzw. 6 Wochen im Jahr 
 (24.12. + 31.12. zusätzlich arbeitsfrei)

Überstunden werden durch zusätzliche Freizeit ausgeglichen 

Benefits

Bis zu 60% mobile Arbeit bei geeigneten Tätigkeiten, überwiegend 2er-Büros, Bus und U-Bahn (U6) vor der Haustür, kostenfreier Parkplatz, Altersvorsorge der Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL), Arbeitsgeräte auf dem neuesten Stand der Technik, Kooperationsvereinbarung mit Anbietern für Sportmöglichkeiten für eine vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft


Das erwartet dich am LRZ:

Du suchst nach einer abwechslungsreichen und anspruchsvollen Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen, kooperativen und innovativen Arbeitsumfeld? Dann bist du am LRZ genau richtig! Spannende Aufgaben im Dienst der Forschung, ein kollegiales, wertschätzendes Miteinander, ein internationales, anregendes, diverses Unternehmensklima; flexibles Arbeiten für eine optimale Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben und viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Das ist bei uns der Standard. Daneben bieten wir in unserem mit modernsten Komponenten ausgestatteten Rechenzentrum natürlich auch alle Vorzüge des öffentlichen Dienstes. Wir teilen Erfahrungen, prüfen und verbessern unsere Abläufe stetig und sind stolz darauf, dass die Qualität unserer Services und die Sicherheit der am LRZ gespeicherten Daten regelmäßig sehr gut bewertet und zertifiziert werden. Wir fördern aktiv Diversität und freuen uns über Bewerbungen talentierter Köpfe, unabhängig von kulturellem Hintergrund, Nationalität, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, geschlechtlicher und sexueller Identität, körperlicher Fähigkeiten, Religion und Alter. title: Senior Rollout Manager (f/m/x) – DACH
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at IONITY GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

IONITY baut ein europaweites Netzwerk von High-Power-Ladestationen auf und betreibt dieses. Als Senior Rollout Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung mehrerer Ladestandorte in der DACH-Region – von der Rollout-Planung und der Standortvorbereitung über die Bauphase, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme bis zur Übergabe an Operations. Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte.
Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Deine Arbeit leistet einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum des europäischen IONITY Netzwerks, sowie einem zuverlässigen Ladeerlebnis für Elektrofahrzeugfahrerinnen und -fahrer aus ganz Europa. Jede neue Ladesäule als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit beschleunigt die Verkehrswende und ist ein wichtiger Beitrag für eine emissionsfreie Mobilität.

  • Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Umsetzung eines Portfolios von HPC-Ladestandorten in der DACH-Region, mit besonderem Fokus auf die komplexesten, risikoreichsten oder strategisch wichtigsten Standorte. Über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg steuerst du Umfang, Zeitplan, Abhängigkeiten, Risikoexponierung, Kostenrisiken, Qualität, Sicherheit, Compliance und die betriebliche Umsetzungsreife.
  • Du übersetzt die Rollout-Ziele in integrierte Standort- und Portfolioumsetzungspläne, definierst Prioritäten, Reihenfolgen, Meilensteine und Abhängigkeiten und stellst eine klare Governance sicher – von der Standortentwicklung und Genehmigungsplanung über die Bauphase und Inbetriebnahme bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du führst die funktionsübergreifende Umsetzung über die Bereiche Planung und Genehmigung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Logistik etc. hinweg, treibst zeitnahe Entscheidungen voran, löst Konflikte und stellst sicher, dass kritische Schnittstellen zwischen Grundstück, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Installation der Ladehardware, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme aktiv gesteuert werden.
  • Du steuerst externe Planungsbüros, Auftragnehmer, Installationsunternehmen und weitere Umsetzungspartner direkt, setzt klare Erwartungen, überwachst die Leistung, steuerst die operative Umsetzung sowie kommerzielle Risiken und stellst sicher, dass die Partner die vereinbarten Ergebnisse liefern.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Risiko-, Änderungs- und Maßnahmenmanagement des Portfolios, identifizierst kritische Risiken frühzeitig, definierst Gegenmaßnahmen und führst Wiederherstellungspläne für verspätete, blockierte oder erheblich vom Plan abweichende Standorte. Dabei schützt du Umsetzungsqualität, Sicherheit und Compliance.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen innerhalb deines übertragenen Verantwortungs- und Entscheidungsrahmens und erstellst klare Entscheidungsvorlagen für den Country Manager DACH, sofern eine Eskalation erforderlich ist. Du stellst tragfähige Optionen, Auswirkungen und Empfehlungen dar und wägst dabei Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, technische Machbarkeit und die Anforderungen der Stakeholder gegeneinander ab.
  • Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern, lokalen Stakeholdern und Umsetzungspartnern auf und pflegst diese, vertrittst IONITY auch in komplexen Gesprächen professionell und löst Genehmigungs-, Netzanschluss-, Grundstücks-, Bau- und sonstige Umsetzungshindernisse pragmatisch.
  • Du erstellst prägnante und entscheidungsorientierte Berichte für Senior Stakeholder, einschließlich Fortschritt, prognostizierter Termine, Prognosesicherheit, wesentlicher Risiken, Kosten- und kommerzieller Risiken, Partnerleistung, Maßnahmen zur Planwiederherstellung sowie der erforderlichen Entscheidungen, um das Portfolio auf Kurs zu halten.
  • Du etablierst und verbesserst kontinuierlich Rollout-Standards, Governance-Routinen, Vorlagen und Umsetzungsleitfäden. Auf Basis gewonnener Erkenntnisse erhöhst du die Planbarkeit, Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Umsetzungseffektivität des Rollouts im gesamten DACH-Netzwerk.


Your profile

  • Du bist ein Teamplayer und arbeitest auch unter Zeitdruck mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität.
  • Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung der Umsetzung komplexer Infrastruktur-, Bau-, Energie-, Mobilitäts-, Telekommunikations- oder vergleichbarer Rollout-Programme über mehrere Standorte hinweg, ideralerweise im Bereich HPC Ladeinfrastruktur.
  • Du kannst eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Übernahme von Ergebnisverantwortung über den gesamten Umsetzungslebenszyklus vorweisen – und nicht nur für einzelne Projektaufgaben oder Arbeitspakete.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Kenntnisse in Programm- und Projektsteuerung, einschließlich integrierter Planung, Risikomanagement, Abhängigkeitsmanagement, Änderungssteuerung und Reporting auf Senior-Ebene.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Partner sowie in der Einflussnahme auf interne Stakeholder in einer Matrixorganisation. Du trittst sicher auf, stellst bestehende Ansätze konstruktiv infrage, triffst Entscheidungen und eskalierst Themen, wenn dies erforderlich ist.
  • Du verfügst über ein fundiertes praktisches Verständnis der Schnittstellen zwischen Standortentwicklung, Genehmigungsplanung, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein und bist bereit, regelmäßig mit Teams an den Standorten zusammenzuarbeiten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Ladeinfrastruktur für Elektrofahrzeuge, Anlagen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien oder anderer dezentraler, kundenorientierter Infrastruktur.
  • Du verfügst über etablierte Arbeitsbeziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern und Baupartnern in einem oder mehreren DACH-Märkten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Schnittstellen zu Hochspannungs- oder elektrotechnischer Infrastruktur sowie mit der Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe in ein operatives Netzwerk.
  • Du verfügst über gute Anwenderkenntnisse in AutoCAD und Microsoft Office, einschließlich fortgeschrittener Excel-Kenntnisse oder vergleichbarer Projektsteuerungs-Tools.
  • Du hast ein einschlägiges Hochschulstudium, eine technische Qualifikation oder vergleichbare berufliche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Bauwesen, Infrastruktur oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.

title: Senior People Operations & Payroll Manager (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at IONITY GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

IONITY is building the backbone of electric mobility in Europe. Founded by leading automotive manufacturers, we operate Europe’s largest high-power charging network across 24 countries, enabling seamless long-distance travel for EV drivers. With thousands of charging points already in operation and significant expansion ahead, IONITY is evolving beyond charging infrastructure into a broader mobility, energy and digital platform. 

As Senior People Ops & Payroll Manager, you'll ensure IONITY's People Operations and payroll run accurately, on time and with care across our multi-country European setup. This is a hands-on role for someone who knows payroll inside out, enjoys making processes cleaner and more scalable, and wants the admin side of work to feel effortless for employees. 

You'll own the payroll cycle end to end, keep our employee data and lifecycle processes in great shape, and be the go-to partner for our external payroll providers, People Partners and employees. 

What you'll do 

  • Own the monthly payroll process across countries, including preparatory payroll accounting, inputs, handovers and sign-off with external payroll providers.
  • Keep employee master data in Personio & Deel accurate, compliant and audit-ready.
  • Manage core lifecycle processes (onboarding, leave, offboarding), including work time accounts, eAUadministration and work certificates.
  • Act as a main contact for payroll providers, tax advisors and auditors, and resolve issues quickly and professionally.
  • Spot friction in processes, systems and workflows, then fix it, using automation and exploring AI where they add real value.
  • Support the alignment of employee benefits across countries while respecting local requirements.
  • Partner closely with People Partners and Finance so payroll, reporting and People processes join up.
  • Answer employee questions on pay and HR admin with clarity and discretion.
  • Guide or mentor junior team members, own larger process and system projects, and act as a sparring partner to People leadership.


Your profile

  • 5 years of experience in payroll and People / HR Operations, ideally including German payroll.
  • Experience coordinating payroll across multiple countries, working with external providers. 
  • Strong knowledge of relevant labor law, tax and social security requirements, with a willingness to learn new countries.
  • Hands-on experience with Deel & Personio is a strong plus.
  • A structured, reliable and discreet way of working, with a real eye for detail and deadlines.
  • A pragmatic, improvement-minded approach: you like clean processes, but not bureaucracy for its own sake.
  • Curiosity about how systems, automation and AI can make work better.
  • Fluent English and German; another European language is a bonus.
  • Proven ownership of multi-country payroll and experience leading process or system improvements, or guiding others.

title: Senior People Operations & Payroll Manager (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at IONITY GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

IONITY is building the backbone of electric mobility in Europe. Founded by leading automotive manufacturers, we operate Europe’s largest high-power charging network across 24 countries, enabling seamless long-distance travel for EV drivers. With thousands of charging points already in operation and significant expansion ahead, IONITY is evolving beyond charging infrastructure into a broader mobility, energy and digital platform. 

As Senior People Ops & Payroll Manager, you'll ensure IONITY's People Operations and payroll run accurately, on time and with care across our multi-country European setup. This is a hands-on role for someone who knows payroll inside out, enjoys making processes cleaner and more scalable, and wants the admin side of work to feel effortless for employees. 

You'll own the payroll cycle end to end, keep our employee data and lifecycle processes in great shape, and be the go-to partner for our external payroll providers, People Partners and employees. 

What you'll do 

  • Own the monthly payroll process across countries, including preparatory payroll accounting, inputs, handovers and sign-off with external payroll providers.
  • Keep employee master data in Personio & Deel accurate, compliant and audit-ready.
  • Manage core lifecycle processes (onboarding, leave, offboarding), including work time accounts, eAUadministration and work certificates.
  • Act as a main contact for payroll providers, tax advisors and auditors, and resolve issues quickly and professionally.
  • Spot friction in processes, systems and workflows, then fix it, using automation and exploring AI where they add real value.
  • Support the alignment of employee benefits across countries while respecting local requirements.
  • Partner closely with People Partners and Finance so payroll, reporting and People processes join up.
  • Answer employee questions on pay and HR admin with clarity and discretion.
  • Guide or mentor junior team members, own larger process and system projects, and act as a sparring partner to People leadership.


Your profile

  • 5 years of experience in payroll and People / HR Operations, ideally including German payroll.
  • Experience coordinating payroll across multiple countries, working with external providers. 
  • Strong knowledge of relevant labor law, tax and social security requirements, with a willingness to learn new countries.
  • Hands-on experience with Deel & Personio is a strong plus.
  • A structured, reliable and discreet way of working, with a real eye for detail and deadlines.
  • A pragmatic, improvement-minded approach: you like clean processes, but not bureaucracy for its own sake.
  • Curiosity about how systems, automation and AI can make work better.
  • Fluent English and German; another European language is a bonus.
  • Proven ownership of multi-country payroll and experience leading process or system improvements, or guiding others.

title: Senior Software Engineer – IT Risk & Pricing (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Auxmoney Gmbh
description_html:
Your new team:

As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) at auxmoney, you’ll join our IT Risk & Pricing team, where we build backend systems and services that support risk decisioning, pricing, and data-driven product logic. The work is backend-heavy, involving complex technical problem-solving and close integration with data/analytics workflows. 
 
In this role, you’ll design and deliver impactful features, help evolve a scalable, resilient architecture, and take end-to-end ownership from concept through production. You’ll work closely with analysts/data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to ship high-quality solutions and continuously improve our engineering standards. If you are passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, solving complex technical challenges, and building software that delivers real value, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


What you can expect:

  • Architecture & System Design: Identify and address architectural limitations, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help evolve systems toward scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a trusted technical expert by promoting engineering best practices, facilitating technical discussions, and helping teams align on high-quality solutions.
  • Engineering Quality: Build solutions that are secure, scalable, extensible, and cost-efficient while maintaining high coding and documentation standards.
  • Execution & Delivery: Break down complex initiatives into manageable workstreams and deliver incremental value through iterative development.
  • Impact & Knowledge Sharing: Champion engineering excellence, share knowledge proactively, and support the professional growth of colleagues.
  • Collaboration & Problem Solving: Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders, actively contribute to design reviews, and address root causes of recurring technical challenges.
  • Ownership & Mentorship: Take responsibility for challenging projects and guide team members through technical mentoring and hands-on support.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset: Balance short-term delivery with long-term system sustainability and continuously look for opportunities to improve technology, processes, and team effectiveness.


Your profile

  • Backend Engineering Expertise: Several years of hands-on backend development experience with preferably strong proficiency in PHP, particularly using the Symfony framework and Python.
  • System & API Development: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust backend systems in production environments, including strong expertise in developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • SQL Expertise: Hands-on SQL experience in application development, with strong proficiency in relational data modelling (table design, keys, and constraints) and writing complex, performant queries to support business features.
  • Cloud & DevOps Practices: Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly valued.
  • Event-Driven Architecture (Bonus): Familiarity with Kafka or similar event-driven messaging systems is considered a strong advantage.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Solid understanding of automated testing strategies, including unit and integration testing, with a focus on delivering reliable and high-quality software aligned with overall quality standards.
  • Product-Oriented Mindset: A strong focus on building solutions that deliver measurable value for users and business outcomes.
  • Team & Communication Skills: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a supportive engineering culture.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: A proactive approach to implementing security best practices and ensuring compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Language Skills: Fluent written and spoken English.


What we offer:

  • Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
  • Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.
  • Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility.
  • Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals.
  • Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed.
  • Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.
  • Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance.
  • Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us.
  • Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle.

For us as an employer, equal opportunities and diversity are especially important. Therefore, we welcome applications from mothers, fathers, people with disabilities and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if, for example, you would like us to use a gender-neutral pronoun, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you would like us to allow more time for the application process.

Wir berichten direkt an den CFO und bündeln Themen wie Internes Kontrollsystem, operationelle Risiken, Incidents, Drittparteien sowie wiederkehrende Bestätigungen der Fachbereiche an einem zentralen Ort. title: Senior Software Engineer – IT Risk & Pricing (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Auxmoney Gmbh
description_html:
Your new team:

As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) at auxmoney, you’ll join our IT Risk & Pricing team, where we build backend systems and services that support risk decisioning, pricing, and data-driven product logic. The work is backend-heavy, involving complex technical problem-solving and close integration with data/analytics workflows. 
 
In this role, you’ll design and deliver impactful features, help evolve a scalable, resilient architecture, and take end-to-end ownership from concept through production. You’ll work closely with analysts/data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to ship high-quality solutions and continuously improve our engineering standards. If you are passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, solving complex technical challenges, and building software that delivers real value, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


What you can expect:

  • Architecture & System Design: Identify and address architectural limitations, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help evolve systems toward scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a trusted technical expert by promoting engineering best practices, facilitating technical discussions, and helping teams align on high-quality solutions.
  • Engineering Quality: Build solutions that are secure, scalable, extensible, and cost-efficient while maintaining high coding and documentation standards.
  • Execution & Delivery: Break down complex initiatives into manageable workstreams and deliver incremental value through iterative development.
  • Impact & Knowledge Sharing: Champion engineering excellence, share knowledge proactively, and support the professional growth of colleagues.
  • Collaboration & Problem Solving: Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders, actively contribute to design reviews, and address root causes of recurring technical challenges.
  • Ownership & Mentorship: Take responsibility for challenging projects and guide team members through technical mentoring and hands-on support.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset: Balance short-term delivery with long-term system sustainability and continuously look for opportunities to improve technology, processes, and team effectiveness.


Your profile

  • Backend Engineering Expertise: Several years of hands-on backend development experience with preferably strong proficiency in PHP, particularly using the Symfony framework and Python.
  • System & API Development: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust backend systems in production environments, including strong expertise in developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • SQL Expertise: Hands-on SQL experience in application development, with strong proficiency in relational data modelling (table design, keys, and constraints) and writing complex, performant queries to support business features.
  • Cloud & DevOps Practices: Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly valued.
  • Event-Driven Architecture (Bonus): Familiarity with Kafka or similar event-driven messaging systems is considered a strong advantage.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Solid understanding of automated testing strategies, including unit and integration testing, with a focus on delivering reliable and high-quality software aligned with overall quality standards.
  • Product-Oriented Mindset: A strong focus on building solutions that deliver measurable value for users and business outcomes.
  • Team & Communication Skills: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a supportive engineering culture.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: A proactive approach to implementing security best practices and ensuring compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.

description_html:

Your responsibilities will include:

  • You plan, coordinate, and deliver training programs for our sales teams and partners, ensuring an engaging and effective learning experience.

  • You create, update, and continuously improve training programs based on business requirements and learning objectives.
  • You develop and maintain high-quality training materials, including course content, e-learning modules, assessments, and certification programs.
  • You collaborate closely with sales teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to align training content with business needs and audience expectations.
  • You support the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of product demonstrations for our sales teams and partners.
  • You act as a subject matter expert in meetings, workshops, and events, providing guidance on sales and product-related topics.
  • You identify opportunities to improve existing training offerings and actively contribute new ideas to enhance our learning and enablement programs.


What you need to succeed

  • You hold a degree in Education, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or have gained equivalent qualifications through relevant professional experience.
  • You are skilled at adapting to different audiences and levels of expertise, delivering content in a clear, practical, and impactful way.
  • You have ideally gained experience in training, enablement, learning & development, or technical support.
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and modern presentation and collaboration tools, and you are confident delivering both in-person and virtual training sessions.
  • You have a solid understanding of the customer journey, sales processes, and common sales methodologies such as SPIN.
  • You possess a strong understanding of business processes and their translation into digital workflows, and you can quickly familiarize yourself with complex software solutions.
  • Experience with DocuWare or other document management solutions is an advantage.
  • You are fluent in both German and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • You work independently, thrive in international team environments, and bring strong communication, networking, and interpersonal skills.


What we can offer

There are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them.

  • Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations.

title: Head of Business Operations / Senior Business Operations Manager - all genders welcome!
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Vicegolf
description_html:
About the Job

Join us in reshaping the future of golf! With a team of over 85 passionate people, we're dedicated to our mission in revolutionizing the golf industry one swing at a time. Our international team, based in Munich, is seeking a motivated Head of Business Operations or Senior Business Operations Manager to become part of our company in a dynamic and innovative environment. In this role, you help translate our revenue targets into an operational plan and bring five independent teams together along this plan. You are the central interface for planning, timing, and alignment in the revenue and marketing area, holding everything together. Ready to embrace your Vice?


Skip the copy paste. Show us your swing

Your CV tells us what you’ve done. We want to understand why those experiences make you the right person for this role. So make your application your own: tailor your CV, tell us about your most relevant achievement, or surprise us with a short presentation. This isn’t a design contest, we’re interested in how you think, what you bring to the table, and what you want to achieve at Vice.


Your Fairway

  • Break down monthly and quarterly D2C targets into weekly and daily targets with specific references to products and promotional campaigns
  • Develop target proposals for C-level executives, who will approve the final plan
  • Maintain the product and promotional calendar, taking processes and deadlines into account
  • Ensuring lead times across five teams (E-commerce & UX, CRM, Performance Marketing, Brand & Marketing, Tech) and identifying and resolving deviations early on
  • Leading the weekly trading review
  • Analyzing problems and developing solutions together with the teams
  • Supporting the expansion of planning to additional sales channels (Green Grass, Specialty Retail, Amazon, etc.)
  • Making independent decisions regarding promotional calendars, discounts, and team prioritization; final decisions regarding budget, pricing, and P&L remain the responsibility of our C-level


Your Scorecard

  • Commercial numerical understanding and judgment rather than pure reporting of numbers

  • Fluency in spoken and written German and English

  • Several years of professional experience (3+ years) in business operations, consulting, chief of staff, commercial, and program management, or comparable experience in complex organizational areas is preferred

  • A background in performance marketing, content, or e-commerce technology is an asset but not a requirement

  • Organizational talent to bring five teams together, identify dependencies early on, and ensure alignment before a gap turns into a problem

  • Critical mindset to challenge the status quo, contribute your own ideas, and actively help shape the future rather than just following plans

  • Structured thinking with foresight

  • Strong communication skills to convince experienced team leads on an equal footing and think creatively with them about the future, while still giving them the space to apply their technical expertise

  • A passion for golf is a plus, but not a requirement 


Note: We use Artificial Intelligence to support this process; the final decision still remains with a human.


Our Clubhouse

  • We embrace diversity and innovation. Our motley team comes from all backgrounds and perspectives, united by fresh and bold ideas.

  • Taking ownership from day one. Our ambitious vision relies on every individual stepping up to bring Vice Golf to the next level.

  • Make your work hours fit your life. Flexible work arrangements and remote work options cater to your work-life balance.

  • Grow with us. We place great emphasis on your personal development, where you benefit from not only regular performance feedback but also an annual training budget.

  • Escape the routine. Within the EU, you’re free to choose your workspace for two weeks a year.

  • Stay active. We’re invested in your well-being, subsidizing EGYM Wellpass so you can train for only 30 € a month.

  • Enjoy! Fuel your day with a varied selection of fresh meals and snacks from our Foodji.

  • Secure your (far) future! While retirement might seem distant to you, we’ve got you covered with options to enroll in our corporate pension plan.

  • Work hard play hard. Work on your golf skills and refine your swing on the state-of-the-art golf simulator and putting green in our office.

  • Enjoy the open bar. Have some Afterwork drinks on our rooftop while enjoying the view of the Alps.

title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Baramundi Software Ag
description_html:
Welcome to baramundi!

“Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”

Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner.

At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features.


Do what you do best:

  • DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.
  • TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input.
  • DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features.
  • BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams.
  • COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development.
  • USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback.


What we appreciate about you:

  • Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment.
  • Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers.
  • Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working.
  • Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures.
  • Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements.
  • Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality.
  • Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.
  • Bonus: background in IT administration, practical knowledge of software development, experience with the Azure technology stack or touchpoints with Linux, macOS, Android or iOS.


Meet us!


10 reasons to choose baramundi!

#1 ARRIVE IN PEACE
Our all-inclusive package makes starting particularly easy. Your personal onboarding buddy will show you everything: from the welcome breakfast to the fully equipped workplace.

#2 FEEL AT HOME
Coffee, fruit, and drinks are free. We take care of your mail and packages. Once a month, all baramundians meet during work hours for pizza and chatting. Just because.

#3 EXPERIENCE VALUE AND APPRECIATION
We believe in values and live them: togetherness and trust. Courage, enthusiasm, and competence. Our communication culture is open and honest. Just like the regular team feedback sessions.

#4 GET REWARDED
You will also feel our appreciation. Success bonuses are as natural as Christmas bonuses, company pension plans, and team events.

#5 ENJOY LIFE
Work time is life time. That’s why you can organize it individually with us. With flexible working hours in full or part-time, home office, and even sabbatical options.

#6 STAY HEALTHY
We want you to feel good. That’s why we have ergonomic furniture and organize health days, massages, yoga, and running groups.

#7 DEVELOP FURTHER
Your personal and professional advancement is important to us. We pay for training and coaching during working hours. Even two-year work stays at our branch in the USA are possible.

#8 WORK AT EYE LEVEL
We are all on a first-name basis, from apprentices to management. We don’t have complicated hierarchies.

#9 YOUR FAMILY IS IMPORTANT TO US
Family means being there, caring, and supporting each other. We do this with daycare subsidies and holiday care, as well as at our family summer festival.

#10 MAKE US EVEN BETTER
We want to be a great place and employer. For that, we need honest feedback.


Contact us!
